blocks.html_en: Toni was formerly the CEO of Automattic, which makes the huge WordPress web content management platform, and you’ll hear him make the case that this period in social networking feels a lot like the early days of the web, and that success looks like a vibrant ecosystem with lots of big players that might take a decade to fully develop.

sentences.en: Toni was formerly the CEO of Automattic, which makes the huge WordPress web content management platform, and you’ll hear him make the case that this period in social networking feels a lot like the early days of the web, and that success looks like a vibrant ecosystem with lots of big players that might take a decade to fully develop.
sentences.zh: Toni 是 Automattic 的前首席执行官，该公司开发了庞大的 WordPress 网络内容管理平台，你会听到他说，社交网络的这段时期感觉很像网络的早期，而成功看起来就像一个充满活力的生态系统，拥有许多大玩家，可能需要十年才能完全发展。

blocks.html_en: That’s quite a vision, but here and now, the open web is falling apart, and the social products of today are fragmenting and in many cases either get smaller or full of AI slop. So we talked about all of that, and about Bluesky’s reputation as a bastion of leftists insulated in their own little bubble sitting next to the increasingly hard right bubble of X. And of course, we talked about how Bluesky might start to generate revenue — and interestingly enough, it’s not just ads.

sentences.en: That’s quite a vision, but here and now, the open web is falling apart, and the social products of today are fragmenting and in many cases either get smaller or full of AI slop.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当美好的愿景，但此时此地，开放网络正在分崩离析，当今的社交产品正在支离破碎，在许多情况下要么变得更小，要么充满了人工智能的废话。

sentences.en: So we talked about all of that, and about Bluesky’s reputation as a bastion of leftists insulated in their own little bubble sitting next to the increasingly hard right bubble of X.
sentences.zh: 所以我们讨论了所有这些，以及 Bluesky 作为左派堡垒的声誉，他们孤立在自己的小泡沫中，与日益强硬的右翼 X 泡沫相邻。

sentences.en: And of course, we talked about how Bluesky might start to generate revenue — and interestingly enough, it’s not just ads.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们讨论了 Bluesky 如何开始创收——有趣的是，这不仅仅是广告。

blocks.html_en: This is a fun one that touches on almost every Decoder theme there is. I think you’re gonna like it.

sentences.en: This is a fun one that touches on almost every Decoder theme there is.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有趣的主题，几乎涉及所有解码器主题。

sentences.en: I think you’re gonna like it.
sentences.zh: 我想你会喜欢的。

blocks.html_en: Okay: Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider. Here we go.

sentences.en: Okay: Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider.
sentences.zh: 好的：Bluesky 首席执行官托尼·施奈德。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 开始了。

blocks.html_en: This interview has been lightly edited for length and clarity.

sentences.en: This interview has been lightly edited for length and clarity.
sentences.zh: 为了篇幅和清晰度，本次采访经过了轻微编辑。

blocks.html_en: Toni Schneider, you are a venture partner at True Ventures, and more importantly, the now permanent CEO of Bluesky. Welcome to Decoder.

sentences.en: Toni Schneider, you are a venture partner at True Ventures, and more importantly, the now permanent CEO of Bluesky.
sentences.zh: Toni Schneider，您是 True Ventures 的风险合伙人，更重要的是，您现在是 Bluesky 的永久首席执行官。

sentences.en: Welcome to Decoder.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到解码器。

blocks.html_en: Thank you. Thanks for having me.

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你有我。

blocks.html_en: I am very excited to talk to you. What is happening with the open social web is maybe the most important thing happening for media. It does not get as much attention as AI, but there’s something very big happening on these interoperable social networks. I know that you are a believer in it in the same way that you believed in the web when you were the CEO of Automattic, which is the company that makes WordPress. So let’s just start at the very start. Describe what you think Bluesky is today and what you think the opportunities with these new kinds of networks are.

sentences.en: I am very excited to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴与你交谈。

sentences.en: What is happening with the open social web is maybe the most important thing happening for media.
sentences.zh: 开放社交网络正在发生的事情可能是媒体发生的最重要的事情。

sentences.en: It does not get as much attention as AI, but there’s something very big happening on these interoperable social networks.
sentences.zh: 它没有像人工智能那样受到那么多关注，但这些可互操作的社交网络上正在发生一些非常大的事情。

sentences.en: I know that you are a believer in it in the same way that you believed in the web when you were the CEO of Automattic, which is the company that makes WordPress.
sentences.zh: 我知道您是它的信徒，就像您担任 Automattic（这家 WordPress 开发公司）首席执行官时对网络的信仰一样。

sentences.en: So let’s just start at the very start.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们从头开始吧。

sentences.en: Describe what you think Bluesky is today and what you think the opportunities with these new kinds of networks are.
sentences.zh: 描述一下您对 Bluesky 的看法，以及您认为这些新型网络的机遇是什么。

blocks.html_en: Bluesky today is really two things. There’s the Bluesky app, which is what a lot of people are familiar with. It’s a social network. We think it’s a better social network. It’s more human focused, doesn’t have ads. It doesn’t have algorithms. But more importantly, underneath Bluesky is an open protocol called AT Protocol. And Bluesky is only one of now over a thousand apps built on that protocol.

sentences.en: Bluesky today is really two things.
sentences.zh: 今天的蓝天确实是两件事。

sentences.en: There’s the Bluesky app, which is what a lot of people are familiar with.
sentences.zh: 有很多人都熟悉的 Bluesky 应用程序。

sentences.en: It’s a social network.
sentences.zh: 这是一个社交网络。

sentences.en: We think it’s a better social network.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这是一个更好的社交网络。

sentences.en: It’s more human focused, doesn’t have ads.
sentences.zh: 它更加人性化，没有广告。

sentences.en: It doesn’t have algorithms.
sentences.zh: 它没有算法。

sentences.en: But more importantly, underneath Bluesky is an open protocol called AT Protocol.
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，Bluesky 的底层是一个开放协议，称为 AT 协议。

sentences.en: And Bluesky is only one of now over a thousand apps built on that protocol.
sentences.zh: Bluesky 只是目前基于该协议构建的一千多个应用程序之一。

blocks.html_en: The whole point of Bluesky was to demonstrate that this open protocol could scale and attract other builders, building lots of apps, lots of social experiences that all interoperate and connect with each other, which is what we believe the future of social media should look like. It’s what is actually going to make social media something that we believe in, which is that the future of social media should serve the public good. That is what motivates us, and that’s why we built the protocol first and then the app.

sentences.en: The whole point of Bluesky was to demonstrate that this open protocol could scale and attract other builders, building lots of apps, lots of social experiences that all interoperate and connect with each other, which is what we believe the future of social media should look like.
sentences.zh: Bluesky 的全部目的是证明这个开放协议可以扩展并吸引其他开发者，构建大量应用程序和大量相互操作和连接的社交体验，这就是我们认为社交媒体的未来应该是什么样子。

sentences.en: It’s what is actually going to make social media something that we believe in, which is that the future of social media should serve the public good.
sentences.zh: 这实际上将使社交媒体成为我们所信仰的东西，即社交媒体的未来应该为公众利益服务。

sentences.en: That is what motivates us, and that’s why we built the protocol first and then the app.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的动力，也是我们首先构建协议然后构建应用程序的原因。

blocks.html_en: There’s a lot in there already that is just pure Decoder bait, including the notion that Bluesky, the product, and the ATmosphere and AT Protocol, the standard, are all intermixed in one company that you now run. Right next to that is maybe the purest Decoder bait of all: the fact that Jay Graber, who was the CEO of Bluesky – she was on the show about two years ago – stepped down into the role of chief innovation officer. You were the interim CEO, and now after four months, you are the full-time CEO. Fundamentally, that is just the story that Decoder loves to tell the most. Talk me through that. What made you step in as the interim CEO, and why did you decide to become the full-time CEO?

sentences.en: There’s a lot in there already that is just pure Decoder bait, including the notion that Bluesky, the product, and the ATmosphere and AT Protocol, the standard, are all intermixed in one company that you now run.
sentences.zh: 其中已经有很多内容只是纯粹的解码器诱饵，包括 Bluesky 产品、ATmosphere 和 AT 协议（标准）都混合在您现在运营的一家公司中的概念。

sentences.en: Right next to that is maybe the purest Decoder bait of all: the fact that Jay Graber, who was the CEO of Bluesky – she was on the show about two years ago – stepped down into the role of chief innovation officer.
sentences.zh: 接下来可能是最纯粹的解码器诱饵：Bluesky 首席执行官杰伊·格雷伯 (Jay Graber)（她大约两年前参加过该节目）卸任首席创新官一职。

sentences.en: You were the interim CEO, and now after four months, you are the full-time CEO.
sentences.zh: 您是临时首席执行官，四个月后，您成为全职首席执行官。

sentences.en: Fundamentally, that is just the story that Decoder loves to tell the most.
sentences.zh: 从根本上来说，这正是 Decoder 最喜欢讲的故事。

sentences.en: Talk me through that.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说这件事。

sentences.en: What made you step in as the interim CEO, and why did you decide to become the full-time CEO?
sentences.zh: 是什么让您担任临时首席执行官？为什么您决定成为全职首席执行官？

blocks.html_en: It’s actually really cool and inspiring that a founder, after she worked on this for six years, got it off the ground. She started inside Twitter, got it out of there, made it an independent thing. There are a lot of reasons why Bluesky is facing long odds and she got into this place, and then felt like it’s at a scale now where [it’s in] her sweet spot, the things that she loves working on, which is vision, innovation, new ideas. She felt pulled back towards building, especially also because of the advent of AI and how AI and AT Proto can interoperate. She felt like that’s what she wants to go work on, and it’s time to find somebody else for the CEO job.

sentences.en: It’s actually really cool and inspiring that a founder, after she worked on this for six years, got it off the ground.
sentences.zh: 事实上，一位创始人在为此工作了六年之后，终于取得了进展，这真的很酷，也很鼓舞人心。

sentences.en: She started inside Twitter, got it out of there, made it an independent thing.
sentences.zh: 她从 Twitter 开始，把它从那里带出来，让它成为一个独立的东西。

sentences.en: There are a lot of reasons why Bluesky is facing long odds and she got into this place, and then felt like it’s at a scale now where [it’s in] her sweet spot, the things that she loves working on, which is vision, innovation, new ideas.
sentences.zh: Bluesky 面临着巨大的困难，而她进入了这个地方，然后感觉现在的规模已经达到了她的最佳位置，她喜欢从事的事情有很多，那就是愿景、创新和新想法。

sentences.en: She felt pulled back towards building, especially also because of the advent of AI and how AI and AT Proto can interoperate.
sentences.zh: 她感到自己被建筑所吸引，特别是因为人工智能的出现以及人工智能和 AT Proto 的互操作方式。

sentences.en: She felt like that’s what she wants to go work on, and it’s time to find somebody else for the CEO job.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这就是她想要从事的工作，是时候寻找其他人来担任首席执行官一职了。

blocks.html_en: I was already involved with this project because I met the team a little bit over two years ago, probably around the same time Jay was on your podcast. We became investors through True Ventures. So I’ve been following it as an investor, supporting it. The team approached me and said that my background with WordPress and open source was a really good fit. And so I agreed to be interim CEO initially because I was still a general partner at True and it’s a firm I helped build. It’s an amazing firm that I didn’t want to leave behind. But also, at True, we’ve had this model where we’ve moved back and forth between operator and investor. I did that while I was running Automattic.

sentences.en: I was already involved with this project because I met the team a little bit over two years ago, probably around the same time Jay was on your podcast.
sentences.zh: 我已经参与了这个项目，因为我在两年多前认识了这个团队，大概在同一时间杰伊出现在你的播客上。

sentences.en: We became investors through True Ventures.
sentences.zh: 我们通过 True Ventures 成为投资者。

sentences.en: So I’ve been following it as an investor, supporting it.
sentences.zh: 所以我作为投资者一直在关注它、支持它。

sentences.en: The team approached me and said that my background with WordPress and open source was a really good fit.
sentences.zh: 该团队找到我并表示我的 WordPress 和开源背景非常适合。

sentences.en: And so I agreed to be interim CEO initially because I was still a general partner at True and it’s a firm I helped build.
sentences.zh: 所以我最初同意担任临时首席执行官，因为我仍然是 True 的普通合伙人，而且这是我帮助建立的公司。

sentences.en: It’s an amazing firm that I didn’t want to leave behind.
sentences.zh: 这是一家很棒的公司，我不想离开。

sentences.en: But also, at True, we’ve had this model where we’ve moved back and forth between operator and investor.
sentences.zh: 而且，在 True，我们也有这种模式，我们在运营商和投资者之间来回切换。

sentences.en: I did that while I was running Automattic.
sentences.zh: 我在运行 Automattic 时就这样做了。

blocks.html_en: So I stepped into it. After working on it hands-on for a few months, it just got more and more fun, more and more energizing. You just feel the momentum. Also, True just switched to a new fund. So actually the timing was good where I could say, “Okay, I will switch my true role to part-time, become a venture partner,” which is what I used to be when I ran Automattic, “and I’ll go all in at Bluesky.”

sentences.en: So I stepped into it.
sentences.zh: 于是我就踏入了其中。

sentences.en: After working on it hands-on for a few months, it just got more and more fun, more and more energizing.
sentences.zh: 经过几个月的亲身实践，它变得越来越有趣，越来越充满活力。

sentences.en: You just feel the momentum.
sentences.zh: 你只是感受到了动力。

sentences.en: Also, True just switched to a new fund.
sentences.zh: 此外，True 刚刚转向一只新基金。

sentences.en: So actually the timing was good where I could say, “Okay, I will switch my true role to part-time, become a venture partner,” which is what I used to be when I ran Automattic, “and I’ll go all in at Bluesky.”
sentences.zh: 所以实际上时机很好，我可以说，“好吧，我将把我的真正角色转变为兼职，成为风险合伙人，”这就是我在经营 Automattic 时所做的，“我会全力以赴地在 Bluesky 工作。”

blocks.html_en: Tell me about the difference between being the interim CEO and the full-time CEO. When you’re the interim CEO, it feels like there are probably some boundaries in what you can do. And then the full-time CEO can obviously do everything that a full-time CEO can do. What did you feel like the boundaries were as interim CEO?

sentences.en: Tell me about the difference between being the interim CEO and the full-time CEO.
sentences.zh: 告诉我临时首席执行官和全职首席执行官之间的区别。

sentences.en: When you’re the interim CEO, it feels like there are probably some boundaries in what you can do.
sentences.zh: 当你担任临时首席执行官时，感觉你能做的事情可能存在一些界限。

sentences.en: And then the full-time CEO can obviously do everything that a full-time CEO can do.
sentences.zh: 那么全职首席执行官显然可以做全职首席执行官能做的一切。

sentences.en: What did you feel like the boundaries were as interim CEO?
sentences.zh: 您认为作为临时首席执行官的界限是什么？

blocks.html_en: On the inside, it hasn’t felt very different. I actually think the move to drop the “interim” is more important on the outside, especially for the ATmosphere and the AT Proto community, and people building on this platform and in this ecosystem just to say, “No, I’m here for the duration. This isn’t just some interim gig and then somebody else is going to show up.” So I felt like, to the outside, that makes a big difference. On the inside, the job really hasn’t changed much..

sentences.en: On the inside, it hasn’t felt very different.
sentences.zh: 在内部，感觉并没有太大不同。

sentences.en: I actually think the move to drop the “interim” is more important on the outside, especially for the ATmosphere and the AT Proto community, and people building on this platform and in this ecosystem just to say, “No, I’m here for the duration.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为放弃“临时”的举动对外部来说更为重要，尤其是对于 ATmosphere 和 AT Proto 社区，以及在这个平台和这个生态系统中构建的人们来说，“不，我会一直在这里。

sentences.en: This isn’t just some interim gig and then somebody else is going to show up.”
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一些临时演出，然后会有其他人出现。”

sentences.en: So I felt like, to the outside, that makes a big difference.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，对于外界来说，这有很大的不同。

sentences.en: On the inside, the job really hasn’t changed much..
sentences.zh: 从内部来看，工作确实没有太大变化。

blocks.html_en: So many of my conversations here in Decoder are really about the timescale of decisions. I’ll make the comparison to my newsroom because it’s easy and it’s easy to understand. Our reporters make decisions in like 30-minute increments. A story comes up, they write it, they publish it, they move on to the next thing. I make decisions maybe in like week- or month-long increments. What are we going to cover? Where are the resources going to go?

sentences.en: So many of my conversations here in Decoder are really about the timescale of decisions.
sentences.zh: 我在 Decoder 中的许多对话实际上都是关于决策的时间尺度。

sentences.en: I’ll make the comparison to my newsroom because it’s easy and it’s easy to understand.
sentences.zh: 我将与我的新闻编辑室进行比较，因为它很容易而且很容易理解。

sentences.en: Our reporters make decisions in like 30-minute increments.
sentences.zh: 我们的记者以大约 30 分钟为增量做出决定。

sentences.en: A story comes up, they write it, they publish it, they move on to the next thing.
sentences.zh: 一个故事出现，他们写下来，出版，然后继续下一件事。

sentences.en: I make decisions maybe in like week- or month-long increments.
sentences.zh: 我可能会以一周或一个月的增量做出决定。

sentences.en: What are we going to cover?
sentences.zh: 我们要讨论什么？

sentences.en: Where are the resources going to go?
sentences.zh: 资源要去哪里？

blocks.html_en: It seems like in the interim CEO role, the timescale of those decisions is necessarily short or it has the appearance of being short. And then I’m reading your note that you published when you became the full-time CEO. In the very beginning of it, you say we’re at the very beginning of the story with a decade of exciting work ahead. And I’m wondering if the timescale of the decisions you’re making now are a decade.

sentences.en: It seems like in the interim CEO role, the timescale of those decisions is necessarily short or it has the appearance of being short.
sentences.zh: 看起来，在临时首席执行官的角色中，这些决策的时间范围必然很短，或者看起来很短。

sentences.en: And then I’m reading your note that you published when you became the full-time CEO.
sentences.zh: 然后我正在阅读您成为全职首席执行官时发表的笔记。

sentences.en: In the very beginning of it, you say we’re at the very beginning of the story with a decade of exciting work ahead.
sentences.zh: 在故事的一开始，你说我们正处于故事的开始，未来十年激动人心的工作即将到来。

sentences.en: And I’m wondering if the timescale of the decisions you’re making now are a decade.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你现在做出的决定的时间尺度是否是十年。

blocks.html_en: Yeah. It touches on something really fascinating with this project. In general with decision making, one of the frameworks I really like is the reversible and irreversible decisions. A lot of decisions we make are actually reversible. I like to optimize to just make those decisions quickly and then make sure you can undo the decisions if you need to change them.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It touches on something really fascinating with this project.
sentences.zh: 它触及了这个项目真正令人着迷的东西。

sentences.en: In general with decision making, one of the frameworks I really like is the reversible and irreversible decisions.
sentences.zh: 一般来说，在决策方面，我真正喜欢的框架之一是可逆和不可逆决策。

sentences.en: A lot of decisions we make are actually reversible.
sentences.zh: 我们做出的很多决定实际上都是可逆的。

sentences.en: I like to optimize to just make those decisions quickly and then make sure you can undo the decisions if you need to change them.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢优化以快速做出这些决定，然后确保在需要更改时可以撤消这些决定。

blocks.html_en: And then there are a few decisions that really do have very long-term implications. They’re much harder to reverse. With this project in particular, there are decisions made at this protocol level that we’re going to have to live with for a long time. There’s a part of the company in this community that thinks very, very, very long term. This is a protocol that is going to be around for decades already. It’s in enough use that it’s going to be around for a long time. Those decisions you really need to be careful about. Then it goes all the way to things we try in the product that work or don’t work.

sentences.en: And then there are a few decisions that really do have very long-term implications.
sentences.zh: 还有一些确实具有非常长期影响的决定。

sentences.en: They’re much harder to reverse.
sentences.zh: 它们更难逆转。

sentences.en: With this project in particular, there are decisions made at this protocol level that we’re going to have to live with for a long time.
sentences.zh: 特别是对于这个项目，我们将不得不在很长一段时间内接受在这个协议级别做出的决定。

sentences.en: There’s a part of the company in this community that thinks very, very, very long term.
sentences.zh: 在这个社区中，公司的一部分人的想法非常非常长远。

sentences.en: This is a protocol that is going to be around for decades already.
sentences.zh: 这是一个已经存在了几十年的协议。

sentences.en: It’s in enough use that it’s going to be around for a long time.
sentences.zh: 它的使用足够多，可以使用很长时间。

sentences.en: Those decisions you really need to be careful about.
sentences.zh: 这些决定你确实需要小心。

sentences.en: Then it goes all the way to things we try in the product that work or don’t work.
sentences.zh: 然后一直到我们在产品中尝试的东西是否有效。

blocks.html_en: I wasn’t in the interim mindset as much because I am also an investor in the company, so I care very much about the long-term picture. What attracts me to this whole endeavor is that it can have a really important long-term impact. I always think about, okay, how will this play out? Does this truly serve the core mission? It’s okay to make some of these harder decisions now that won’t pay off for a long time because this is going to take a while.

sentences.en: I wasn’t in the interim mindset as much because I am also an investor in the company, so I care very much about the long-term picture.
sentences.zh: 我并没有太多的临时心态，因为我也是公司的投资者，所以我非常关心长期前景。

sentences.en: What attracts me to this whole endeavor is that it can have a really important long-term impact.
sentences.zh: 这整个努力吸引我的是它可以产生非常重要的长期影响。

sentences.en: I always think about, okay, how will this play out?
sentences.zh: 我总是在想，好吧，这件事会如何发展？

sentences.en: Does this truly serve the core mission?
sentences.zh: 这真的能服务于核心使命吗？

sentences.en: It’s okay to make some of these harder decisions now that won’t pay off for a long time because this is going to take a while.
sentences.zh: 现在做出一些更困难的决定是可以的，但这些决定在很长一段时间内不会有回报，因为这需要一段时间。

blocks.html_en: It’s not just one company. It’s already thousands of others that are building together. That’s just a different timeframe and decision-making process than your typical just “go fast, scale as quickly as possible” [methodology]. I like it. I’m comfortable with it.

sentences.en: It’s not just one company.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一家公司。

sentences.en: It’s already thousands of others that are building together.
sentences.zh: 已经有成千上万的其他人正在一起建设。

sentences.en: That’s just a different timeframe and decision-making process than your typical just “go fast, scale as quickly as possible” [methodology].
sentences.zh: 这只是一个与典型的“快速行动，尽快扩展”[方法]不同的时间框架和决策过程。

sentences.en: I like it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它。

sentences.en: I’m comfortable with it.
sentences.zh: 我对此很满意。

blocks.html_en: I just want to stick with Bluesky, the company that is both responsible for the standard and the protocol, and the product that a lot of end users love and sometimes hate. That is the core tension of the company. The user base of Bluesky is or is not interested in the development of AT Protocol, is or is not interested in the wider ATmosphere.

sentences.en: I just want to stick with Bluesky, the company that is both responsible for the standard and the protocol, and the product that a lot of end users love and sometimes hate.
sentences.zh: 我只是想坚持使用 Bluesky，这家公司既负责标准又负责协议，而且它的产品让很多最终用户又爱又恨。

sentences.en: That is the core tension of the company.
sentences.zh: 这是公司的核心压力。

sentences.en: The user base of Bluesky is or is not interested in the development of AT Protocol, is or is not interested in the wider ATmosphere.
sentences.zh: Bluesky 的用户群对 AT 协议的开发感兴趣或不感兴趣，对更广泛的 ATmosphere 感兴趣或不感兴趣。

blocks.html_en: Under Jay’s tenure, the company was very focused on building out the protocol because the product literally could not exist unless the protocol was robust enough to stand up the product. You could see that back and forth. I have always felt that the company is far more interested in the protocol than the product, that the product was merely there to show what people could do.

sentences.en: Under Jay’s tenure, the company was very focused on building out the protocol because the product literally could not exist unless the protocol was robust enough to stand up the product.
sentences.zh: 在杰伊的任期内，该公司非常专注于构建协议，因为除非协议足够强大以支持该产品，否则该产品实际上无法存在。

sentences.en: You could see that back and forth.
sentences.zh: 你可以来回看到这一点。

sentences.en: I have always felt that the company is far more interested in the protocol than the product, that the product was merely there to show what people could do.
sentences.zh: 我一直觉得公司对协议比对产品更感兴趣，产品只是为了展示人们可以做什么。

blocks.html_en: But now the product is big. It might be waxing or waning. It will come to whether you need to turn it into TikTok or not. Tell me where you, as a CEO with a decade-long vision for all of this, see the balance inside of Bluesky between the product, the thing that looks like a Twitter app, and the protocol, the thing that should enable thousands upon thousands of other social experiences?

sentences.en: But now the product is big.
sentences.zh: 但现在产品很大了。

sentences.en: It might be waxing or waning.
sentences.zh: 它可能正在增加或减少。

sentences.en: It will come to whether you need to turn it into TikTok or not.
sentences.zh: 就看你是否需要把它变成TikTok了。

sentences.en: Tell me where you, as a CEO with a decade-long vision for all of this, see the balance inside of Bluesky between the product, the thing that looks like a Twitter app, and the protocol, the thing that should enable thousands upon thousands of other social experiences?
sentences.zh: 告诉我，作为一位对这一切有着长达十年愿景的首席执行官，您如何看待 Bluesky 内部产品（看起来像 Twitter 应用程序的东西）和协议（应该实现成千上万种其他社交体验的东西）之间的平衡？

blocks.html_en: I see the Bluesky app and the product as enabling the ATmosphere. It’s an on-ramp, or maybe a lobby to the ATmosphere where it’s just a great way to get lots of people in, get people exposed to the idea, and then realize as you use the product, “Oh, there are other things here. This isn’t just a microblogging app.”

sentences.en: I see the Bluesky app and the product as enabling the ATmosphere.
sentences.zh: 我认为 Bluesky 应用程序和产品支持 ATmosphere。

sentences.en: It’s an on-ramp, or maybe a lobby to the ATmosphere where it’s just a great way to get lots of people in, get people exposed to the idea, and then realize as you use the product, “Oh, there are other things here.
sentences.zh: 它是一个入口匝道，或者可能是通往大气层的大厅，这是吸引很多人进来的好方法，让人们接触到这个想法，然后在使用该产品时意识到，“哦，这里还有其他东西。

sentences.en: This isn’t just a microblogging app.”
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一个微博应用程序。”

blocks.html_en: An example from the last couple of months that’s gone super well is this format called Standard Site that emerged. The history of that is that Bluesky’s a microblogging app. People are asking for longer-form posting. A bunch of other apps started popping up that were for newsletters and blogging. In particular, three apps called Leaflet, Pckt, and Offprint. They got together and said, “Hey, why don’t we define a format for all of us to work together on the ATmosphere for all of the posts that we publish?” We looked at it and said, “Great, we can now take that and surface it in our app.”

sentences.en: An example from the last couple of months that’s gone super well is this format called Standard Site that emerged.
sentences.zh: 过去几个月进展非常顺利的一个例子是出现的这种称为“标准站点”的格式。

sentences.en: The history of that is that Bluesky’s a microblogging app.
sentences.zh: Bluesky 的历史是一款微博应用程序。

sentences.en: People are asking for longer-form posting.
sentences.zh: 人们要求发布更长的内容。

sentences.en: A bunch of other apps started popping up that were for newsletters and blogging.
sentences.zh: 许多其他用于新闻通讯和博客的应用程序开始出现。

sentences.en: In particular, three apps called Leaflet, Pckt, and Offprint.
sentences.zh: 特别是三个名为 Leaflet、Pckt 和 Offprint 的应用程序。

sentences.en: They got together and said, “Hey, why don’t we define a format for all of us to work together on the ATmosphere for all of the posts that we publish?”
sentences.zh: 他们聚在一起说：“嘿，为什么我们不定义一种格式，让我们所有人在 ATmosphere 上共同发布我们发布的所有帖子呢？”

sentences.en: We looked at it and said, “Great, we can now take that and surface it in our app.”
sentences.zh: 我们看着它并说：“太好了，我们现在可以将其呈现在我们的应用程序中。”

blocks.html_en: So now, if you’re posting a blog post on Leaflet, it just shows up in the Bluesky app and we can make that a seamless experience. This went over really well to the point where now WordPress is supporting Standard Site and lots of other publishing platforms. They’re realizing the benefit of, “If I just publish to this new format now, it’s going to show up and work across all these other platforms without me having to do anything.” It’s caused this really nice ripple effect throughout the ecosystem where people can work together just by using this format. Nobody has to do deals with each other. Nobody has to get permissions and no money has to change hands. And it’s just taken off.

sentences.en: So now, if you’re posting a blog post on Leaflet, it just shows up in the Bluesky app and we can make that a seamless experience.
sentences.zh: 因此，现在，如果您在 Leaflet 上发布博客文章，它只会显示在 Bluesky 应用程序中，我们可以使其成为无缝体验。

sentences.en: This went over really well to the point where now WordPress is supporting Standard Site and lots of other publishing platforms.
sentences.zh: 一切进展顺利，现在 WordPress 支持标准站点和许多其他发布平台。

sentences.en: They’re realizing the benefit of, “If I just publish to this new format now, it’s going to show up and work across all these other platforms without me having to do anything.”
sentences.zh: 他们意识到这样的好处：“如果我现在就发布这种新格式，它就会在所有其他平台上显示并运行，而无需我做任何事情。”

sentences.en: It’s caused this really nice ripple effect throughout the ecosystem where people can work together just by using this format.
sentences.zh: 它在整个生态系统中引起了非常好的连锁反应，人们只需使用这种格式就可以一起工作。

sentences.en: Nobody has to do deals with each other.
sentences.zh: 没有人必须互相做交易。

sentences.en: Nobody has to get permissions and no money has to change hands.
sentences.zh: 没有人需要获得许可，也不需要资金易手。

sentences.en: And it’s just taken off.
sentences.zh: 而且它刚刚起飞。

blocks.html_en: I’m hoping more and more Bluesky users will see those kinds of integrations and go, “Oh, cool. I’m not just getting Bluesky content here. I’m getting content from all these other apps, all these other networks. And it just works. I don’t have to do anything. I don’t have to go sign up for 10 different apps. It’s just one signup, one account, and it just works.”

sentences.en: I’m hoping more and more Bluesky users will see those kinds of integrations and go, “Oh, cool.
sentences.zh: 我希望越来越多的 Bluesky 用户会看到这些类型的集成，并会说：“哦，太酷了。

sentences.en: I’m not just getting Bluesky content here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里获取的不仅仅是 Bluesky 的内容。

sentences.en: I’m getting content from all these other apps, all these other networks.
sentences.zh: 我从所有其他应用程序、所有其他网络获取内容。

sentences.en: And it just works.
sentences.zh: 它确实有效。

sentences.en: I don’t have to do anything.
sentences.zh: 我不需要做任何事情。

sentences.en: I don’t have to go sign up for 10 different apps.
sentences.zh: 我不必去注册 10 个不同的应用程序。

sentences.en: It’s just one signup, one account, and it just works.”
sentences.zh: 只需注册一个帐户，即可使用。”

blocks.html_en: You’re describing two different kinds of things. There’s a lot of work to be done at the protocol level. There’s a lot of work to be done to support new kinds of experiences like Standard Site. Then there’s Bluesky, a product which has 45 million people, and probably needs to be substantially bigger if it wants to be the aggregator for a massive network that can displace some of the other social products out there. That needs to be a lot of things to a lot of people. It needs to find different kinds of product market fit. How big is Bluesky the company now, and how is it structured to point in two different directions?

sentences.en: You’re describing two different kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 您正在描述两种不同的事物。

sentences.en: There’s a lot of work to be done at the protocol level.
sentences.zh: 在协议层面还有很多工作要做。

sentences.en: There’s a lot of work to be done to support new kinds of experiences like Standard Site.
sentences.zh: 要支持标准站点等新型体验，还有很多工作要做。

sentences.en: Then there’s Bluesky, a product which has 45 million people, and probably needs to be substantially bigger if it wants to be the aggregator for a massive network that can displace some of the other social products out there.
sentences.zh: 然后是 Bluesky，这是一款拥有 4500 万用户的产品，如果它想成为一个可以取代其他一些社交产品的大型网络的聚合器，它可能需要大幅扩大规模。

sentences.en: That needs to be a lot of things to a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 对于很多人来说，这需要是很多事情。

sentences.en: It needs to find different kinds of product market fit.
sentences.zh: 它需要找到适合市场的不同类型的产品。

sentences.en: How big is Bluesky the company now, and how is it structured to point in two different directions?
sentences.zh: Bluesky 公司现在有多大？它的结构是如何指向两个不同的方向的？

blocks.html_en: We’re now at 50 people, still very small. The biggest challenge is clearly trying to do everything you’ve described with a small team. We do have an ecosystem of hundreds and thousands of others working on it, so that helps. We do our best to coordinate everyone.

sentences.en: We’re now at 50 people, still very small.
sentences.zh: 我们现在有 50 人，仍然很小。

sentences.en: The biggest challenge is clearly trying to do everything you’ve described with a small team.
sentences.zh: 最大的挑战显然是试图用一个小团队完成你所描述的所有事情。

sentences.en: We do have an ecosystem of hundreds and thousands of others working on it, so that helps.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有一个由成百上千的其他人组成的生态系统，所以这很有帮助。

sentences.en: We do our best to coordinate everyone.
sentences.zh: 我们尽力协调大家。

blocks.html_en: I would say we’re making good progress. We’re seeing good momentum, especially on the ATmosphere side. The things we look at are the number of daily active apps on the network, which has doubled since the beginning of the year. It’s about to hit a thousand. We look at SDK downloads for our tools that have tripled. It’s going to hit a million downloads a month by later this year. Those are the numbers that show that not only is it scaling, but we’re able to scale it with the team that we have.

sentences.en: I would say we’re making good progress.
sentences.zh: 我想说我们正在取得良好进展。

sentences.en: We’re seeing good momentum, especially on the ATmosphere side.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了良好的势头，尤其是在大气层方面。

sentences.en: The things we look at are the number of daily active apps on the network, which has doubled since the beginning of the year.
sentences.zh: 我们关注的是网络上每日活跃应用程序的数量，自今年年初以来已经翻了一番。

sentences.en: It’s about to hit a thousand.
sentences.zh: 快要破千了。

sentences.en: We look at SDK downloads for our tools that have tripled.
sentences.zh: 我们看到我们工具的 SDK 下载量增加了两倍。

sentences.en: It’s going to hit a million downloads a month by later this year.
sentences.zh: 到今年晚些时候，每月下载量将达到 100 万次。

sentences.en: Those are the numbers that show that not only is it scaling, but we’re able to scale it with the team that we have.
sentences.zh: 这些数字表明，它不仅在扩展，而且我们能够与我们拥有的团队一起扩展它。

blocks.html_en: How is that team structured?

sentences.en: How is that team structured?
sentences.zh: 该团队的结构如何？

blocks.html_en: About 50 people, all remote, structured into small teams. I’m a big believer that six to eight person teams, highly aligned, highly incentivized, and motivated are the way to get things done. Probably the only way to get things done. There are three core product teams. There’s the app team that deals with the Bluesky app. There’s the ATmosphere team that does all the developer-facing stuff. And then there’s a third product team called the exploration team, and that’s a new team that Jay has stood up and is running. We actually just launched a new version of the product they’re working on, Attie. Think of it as AI layered on top of the ATmosphere and what you can do with that.

sentences.en: About 50 people, all remote, structured into small teams.
sentences.zh: 大约 50 人，全部远程，组成小团队。

sentences.en: I’m a big believer that six to eight person teams, highly aligned, highly incentivized, and motivated are the way to get things done.
sentences.zh: 我坚信，六到八人的团队，高度协调，高度激励，积极主动，才是完成工作的方法。

sentences.en: Probably the only way to get things done.
sentences.zh: 可能是完成任务的唯一方法。

sentences.en: There are three core product teams.
sentences.zh: 共有三个核心产品团队。

sentences.en: There’s the app team that deals with the Bluesky app.
sentences.zh: 有一个应用程序团队负责处理 Bluesky 应用程序。

sentences.en: There’s the ATmosphere team that does all the developer-facing stuff.
sentences.zh: ATmosphere 团队负责所有面向开发人员的工作。

sentences.en: And then there’s a third product team called the exploration team, and that’s a new team that Jay has stood up and is running.
sentences.zh: 然后还有第三个产品团队，称为探索团队，这是杰伊建立并运行的新团队。

sentences.en: We actually just launched a new version of the product they’re working on, Attie.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们刚刚推出了他们正在开发的产品的新版本，Attie。

sentences.en: Think of it as AI layered on top of the ATmosphere and what you can do with that.
sentences.zh: 将其视为分层在 ATmosphere 之上的人工智能以及您可以用它做什么。

blocks.html_en: Those are our three core product teams, and they’re each customer-facing. Consumer-facing, developer-facing, and then we’ll find out from the AI product what the market fit is there. We have a bunch of support teams that support those three core teams and that are pretty typical. We’ve got a legal team, et cetera, et cetera. I would say it’s a team that’s a very low ego, high agency. That is kind of the ethos. Low drama, just a lot of get-shit-done energy. Really collaborative.

sentences.en: Those are our three core product teams, and they’re each customer-facing.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的三个核心产品团队，他们每个团队都面向客户。

sentences.en: Consumer-facing, developer-facing, and then we’ll find out from the AI product what the market fit is there.
sentences.zh: 面向消费者，面向开发者，然后我们会从AI产品中找到适合的市场。

sentences.en: We have a bunch of support teams that support those three core teams and that are pretty typical.
sentences.zh: 我们有一群支持这三个核心团队的支持团队，这是非常典型的。

sentences.en: We’ve got a legal team, et cetera, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个法律团队等等。

sentences.en: I would say it’s a team that’s a very low ego, high agency.
sentences.zh: 我想说这是一个非常低自我、高度代理的团队。

sentences.en: That is kind of the ethos.
sentences.zh: 这就是一种精神。

sentences.en: Low drama, just a lot of get-shit-done energy.
sentences.zh: 低戏剧性，只是大量完成任务的能量。

sentences.en: Really collaborative.
sentences.zh: 真正协作。

blocks.html_en: Whenever I think about new social products and how they might scale, especially with explosive user growth – up until recently, the conventional wisdom is you’ve got to scale trust and safety and moderation linearly with the size of your user base. Maybe we’re going to add AI to this and that linear relationship will break, or maybe it’ll actually get even more costly because token spend will get more costly than having human moderators, or there’ll be more false positives and we’re going to be even angrier. So you have to have more humans in the loop.

sentences.en: Whenever I think about new social products and how they might scale, especially with explosive user growth – up until recently, the conventional wisdom is you’ve got to scale trust and safety and moderation linearly with the size of your user base.
sentences.zh: 每当我想到新的社交产品以及它们如何扩展时，尤其是在用户爆炸式增长的情况下，直到最近，传统观点是你必须根据用户群的规模线性扩展信任、安全和节制。

sentences.en: Maybe we’re going to add AI to this and that linear relationship will break, or maybe it’ll actually get even more costly because token spend will get more costly than having human moderators, or there’ll be more false positives and we’re going to be even angrier.
sentences.zh: 也许我们要在其中添加人工智能，这种线性关系就会被打破，或者它实际上会变得更加昂贵，因为代币支出将比人工审核者成本更高，或者会出现更多误报，我们会更加愤怒。

sentences.en: So you have to have more humans in the loop.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须有更多的人参与进来。

blocks.html_en: It’s really unclear to me how that’s going to work. You’ve obviously been scaling Bluesky as a consumer social product. Then you have the complexity of, “We’re hooking onto lots and lots of other products that are putting content in front of people.” How does the moderation layer work? And have you seen it be a linear increase in cost with the size of the network and the user base?

sentences.en: It’s really unclear to me how that’s going to work.
sentences.zh: 我真的不清楚这将如何运作。

sentences.en: You’ve obviously been scaling Bluesky as a consumer social product.
sentences.zh: 显然，您一直在将 Bluesky 扩展为消费者社交产品。

sentences.en: Then you have the complexity of, “We’re hooking onto lots and lots of other products that are putting content in front of people.”
sentences.zh: 那么你就会遇到这样的复杂情况：“我们正在连接很多很多其他产品，这些产品将内容呈现在人们面前。”

sentences.en: How does the moderation layer work?
sentences.zh: 调节层如何工作？

sentences.en: And have you seen it be a linear increase in cost with the size of the network and the user base?
sentences.zh: 您是否看到成本随着网络规模和用户群的增长而线性增加？

blocks.html_en: Moderation is huge in any social product. In addition to our 50-person team, we do have contractors that help us with moderation. What we’ve done differently is that our whole moderation system is composable or pluggable. It’s not just us that can label content and moderate it. Anybody can do it and add labels. It’s part of the protocol. Anybody else who builds products can decide if they want to use those labels or not. So if somebody on our moderation team labels something as, let’s say, AI slop, everybody else who’s building in this ecosystem can take advantage of that piece of data. They don’t have to, but they can.

sentences.en: Moderation is huge in any social product.
sentences.zh: 对于任何社交产品来说，适度都是很重要的。

sentences.en: In addition to our 50-person team, we do have contractors that help us with moderation.
sentences.zh: 除了我们 50 人的团队之外，我们还有帮助我们进行审核的承包商。

sentences.en: What we’ve done differently is that our whole moderation system is composable or pluggable.
sentences.zh: 我们所做的不同之处在于我们的整个审核系统是可组合的或可插入的。

sentences.en: It’s not just us that can label content and moderate it.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是我们可以标记内容并对其进行审核。

sentences.en: Anybody can do it and add labels.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以做到并添加标签。

sentences.en: It’s part of the protocol.
sentences.zh: 这是协议的一部分。

sentences.en: Anybody else who builds products can decide if they want to use those labels or not.
sentences.zh: 任何制造产品的其他人都可以决定是否要使用这些标签。

sentences.en: So if somebody on our moderation team labels something as, let’s say, AI slop, everybody else who’s building in this ecosystem can take advantage of that piece of data.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们的审核团队中的某个人将某件事贴上人工智能垃圾的标签，那么在这个生态系统中构建的其他人都可以利用该数据。

sentences.en: They don’t have to, but they can.
sentences.zh: 他们不必这样做，但他们可以。

blocks.html_en: So what we’re seeing and what we’ve seen is we have our moderation team, but then there are other teams that have decided to moderate label content the way they want. For example, maybe the first non-Bluesky project on the protocol was Blacksky. And it’s now become a thriving company on its own. It’s a team building all kinds of interesting things. And they started out by saying, “Hey, we want to build a version of this network that is optimized for Black users and their needs. And we want to have our own moderation policies.” And they are able to do that and plug that in. But everything they’re doing is still part of the larger network. And now there are hundreds and thousands of these kinds of systems.

sentences.en: So what we’re seeing and what we’ve seen is we have our moderation team, but then there are other teams that have decided to moderate label content the way they want.
sentences.zh: 所以我们所看到的和我们所看到的是我们有我们的审核团队，但还有其他团队决定按照他们想要的方式审核标签内容。

sentences.en: For example, maybe the first non-Bluesky project on the protocol was Blacksky.
sentences.zh: 例如，该协议上的第一个非 Bluesky 项目可能是 Blacksky。

sentences.en: And it’s now become a thriving company on its own.
sentences.zh: 现在它已经成为一家蓬勃发展的公司。

sentences.en: It’s a team building all kinds of interesting things.
sentences.zh: 这是一个打造各种有趣事物的团队。

sentences.en: And they started out by saying, “Hey, we want to build a version of this network that is optimized for Black users and their needs.
sentences.zh: 他们一开始就说：“嘿，我们希望构建一个针对黑人用户及其需求进行优化的网络版本。

sentences.en: And we want to have our own moderation policies.”
sentences.zh: 我们希望有自己的节制政策。”

sentences.en: And they are able to do that and plug that in.
sentences.zh: 他们能够做到这一点并将其插入。

sentences.en: But everything they’re doing is still part of the larger network.
sentences.zh: 但他们所做的一切仍然是更大网络的一部分。

sentences.en: And now there are hundreds and thousands of these kinds of systems.
sentences.zh: 现在有成百上千个这样的系统。

blocks.html_en: This has really helped where the moderation burden isn’t all on one team that has to scale and look at everything. There should be lots of different teams and lots of different systems because each network, each community has its own idea of what moderation should look like. So we feel like this kind of distributed moderation approach is more powerful. That said, yes, we’re continuing to scale up ours, but it’s manageable. It’s a lot of work, but it’s manageable. It’s worth it when the whole network can benefit from it.

sentences.en: This has really helped where the moderation burden isn’t all on one team that has to scale and look at everything.
sentences.zh: 当审核负担并不全部落在一个必须扩展和审视一切的团队身上时，这确实很有帮助。

sentences.en: There should be lots of different teams and lots of different systems because each network, each community has its own idea of what moderation should look like.
sentences.zh: 应该有很多不同的团队和很多不同的系统，因为每个网络、每个社区对于审核应该是什么样子都有自己的想法。

sentences.en: So we feel like this kind of distributed moderation approach is more powerful.
sentences.zh: 所以我们觉得这种分布式审核方法更强大。

sentences.en: That said, yes, we’re continuing to scale up ours, but it’s manageable.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，是的，我们正在继续扩大规模，但这是可控的。

sentences.en: It’s a lot of work, but it’s manageable.
sentences.zh: 虽然工作量很大，但这是可以管理的。

sentences.en: It’s worth it when the whole network can benefit from it.
sentences.zh: 当整个网络都能从中受益时，这是值得的。

blocks.html_en: The next part of that story that’s going to be really interesting is that the biggest thing we’re actually working on with AT Proto, the next evolution of the protocol, is private data. We all know that the public square, public social networking has reached a certain scale. And there are a lot of people who want to retreat into more private spaces. We’ve seen explosive growth in group chats. We’re all in a million group chats. This has been the number-one request from our community, from our developers: “Let us build more private, membership-based, various versions of private spaces on this protocol.”

sentences.en: The next part of that story that’s going to be really interesting is that the biggest thing we’re actually working on with AT Proto, the next evolution of the protocol, is private data.
sentences.zh: 这个故事的下一部分非常有趣，我们实际上正在与 AT Proto（该协议的下一个演进）合作的最重要的事情是私有数据。

sentences.en: We all know that the public square, public social networking has reached a certain scale.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道，公共广场、公共社交网络已经达到一定规模。

sentences.en: And there are a lot of people who want to retreat into more private spaces.
sentences.zh: 而且有很多人想要退回到更私人的空间。

sentences.en: We’ve seen explosive growth in group chats.
sentences.zh: 我们看到群聊的爆炸式增长。

sentences.en: We’re all in a million group chats.
sentences.zh: 我们都在一百万个群聊中。

sentences.en: This has been the number-one request from our community, from our developers: “Let us build more private, membership-based, various versions of private spaces on this protocol.”
sentences.zh: 这是我们社区和开发人员的首要要求：“让我们在这个协议上构建更多私人的、基于会员的、各种版本的私人空间。”

blocks.html_en: We’re in the middle of building that. It’s a community effort. It’s rolling out very soon. Now, moderation moves and gets broken up into even more and smaller spaces. People can decide, “If I don’t like a network or I don’t like the way it’s moderated, [I can] go start my own.” Go start your own community. That’s the most interesting thing ahead of us, because right now everything on AT Proto is public. It can only be used for a completely public product. Once we enable private data, I think that it’s like 10 or 100X the number of use cases we can serve.

sentences.en: We’re in the middle of building that.
sentences.zh: 我们正在构建它。

sentences.en: It’s a community effort.
sentences.zh: 这是社区的努力。

sentences.en: It’s rolling out very soon.
sentences.zh: 它很快就会推出。

sentences.en: Now, moderation moves and gets broken up into even more and smaller spaces.
sentences.zh: 现在，节制运动并被分解成更多、更小的空间。

sentences.en: People can decide, “If I don’t like a network or I don’t like the way it’s moderated, [I can] go start my own.”
sentences.zh: 人们可以决定，“如果我不喜欢某个网络或者我不喜欢它的管理方式，[我可以]创建自己的网络。”

sentences.en: Go start your own community.
sentences.zh: 去创建你自己的社区吧。

sentences.en: That’s the most interesting thing ahead of us, because right now everything on AT Proto is public.
sentences.zh: 这是我们面前最有趣的事情，因为现在 AT Proto 上的所有内容都是公开的。

sentences.en: It can only be used for a completely public product.
sentences.zh: 它只能用于完全公共的产品。

sentences.en: Once we enable private data, I think that it’s like 10 or 100X the number of use cases we can serve.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们启用私有数据，我认为我们可以服务的用例数量会增加 10 倍或 100 倍。

blocks.html_en: Not to be reductive, but I think it’s useful to talk about this in comparison to other social products people might be more familiar with. With AT Protocol right now and the ATmosphere, everything is very public. The models in my head are Twitter, and RSS, and massive broad-based publishing platforms, right? One-to-many. I think what you’re describing is much more like a Reddit style approach, where you have smaller, closed communities. Some of them can be totally private unless you’re invited in. And yet, they’re still on the ATmosphere in some way. Is that right?

sentences.en: Not to be reductive, but I think it’s useful to talk about this in comparison to other social products people might be more familiar with.
sentences.zh: 并不是要简单化，但我认为与人们可能更熟悉的其他社交产品相比来讨论这一点是有用的。

sentences.en: With AT Protocol right now and the ATmosphere, everything is very public.
sentences.zh: 现在有了 AT Protocol 和 ATmosphere，一切都是非常公开的。

sentences.en: The models in my head are Twitter, and RSS, and massive broad-based publishing platforms, right?
sentences.zh: 我脑海中的模型是 Twitter、RSS 以及大规模的广泛发布平台，对吗？

sentences.en: One-to-many.
sentences.zh: 一对多。

sentences.en: I think what you’re describing is much more like a Reddit style approach, where you have smaller, closed communities.
sentences.zh: 我认为你所描述的更像是 Reddit 风格的方法，其中你有更小的、封闭的社区。

sentences.en: Some of them can be totally private unless you’re invited in.
sentences.zh: 其中一些可能是完全私人的，除非您被邀请参加。

sentences.en: And yet, they’re still on the ATmosphere in some way.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们仍然以某种方式存在于大气层中。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

blocks.html_en: That’s right. The trade-off has traditionally been that if you want to be on a launch network, you have to be on a public network. Or if you want to control, have ownership over your own community, you have to set up your own thing. You have to run your own server or you have to run your own forum. There’s clearly a need for that because there are lots of those out there. But the challenge is each one of those is now a little island. And you have to convince people.

sentences.en: That’s right.
sentences.zh: 这是正确的。

sentences.en: The trade-off has traditionally been that if you want to be on a launch network, you have to be on a public network.
sentences.zh: 传统上的权衡是，如果你想进入发布网络，就必须进入公共网络。

sentences.en: Or if you want to control, have ownership over your own community, you have to set up your own thing.
sentences.zh: 或者，如果你想控制、拥有自己社区的所有权，你就必须建立自己的东西。

sentences.en: You have to run your own server or you have to run your own forum.
sentences.zh: 您必须运行自己的服务器或者必须运行自己的论坛。

sentences.en: There’s clearly a need for that because there are lots of those out there.
sentences.zh: 显然有必要这样做，因为那里有很多这样的东西。

sentences.en: But the challenge is each one of those is now a little island.
sentences.zh: 但挑战在于，其中每一个现在都是一座小岛。

sentences.en: And you have to convince people.
sentences.zh: 你必须说服人们。

blocks.html_en: We think we can pull off as the best of both worlds. When you build a community or private space on AT Proto, it’s absolutely 100% owned by you. It’s not owned by Bluesky or by any company. It’s just like everything else on a protocol. It’s owned by the users, not by the platform. So it’s really truly yours. You can move it around. You can make all the decisions. But because it’s on a shared protocol, all of these communities plug together. You can go to a place like Bluesky and get all your notifications in one place. You can see what’s going on across everything. You just need one login, one place to check, but you still have the independence and the identity of these individual communities.

sentences.en: We think we can pull off as the best of both worlds.
sentences.zh: 我们认为我们可以实现两全其美。

sentences.en: When you build a community or private space on AT Proto, it’s absolutely 100% owned by you.
sentences.zh: 当您在 AT Proto 上建立社区或私人空间时，它绝对 100% 归您所有。

sentences.en: It’s not owned by Bluesky or by any company.
sentences.zh: 它不属于 Bluesky 或任何公司所有。

sentences.en: It’s just like everything else on a protocol.
sentences.zh: 就像协议上的其他所有内容一样。

sentences.en: It’s owned by the users, not by the platform.
sentences.zh: 它属于用户，而不属于平台。

sentences.en: So it’s really truly yours.
sentences.zh: 所以它真的是你的。

sentences.en: You can move it around.
sentences.zh: 你可以移动它。

sentences.en: You can make all the decisions.
sentences.zh: 您可以做出所有决定。

sentences.en: But because it’s on a shared protocol, all of these communities plug together.
sentences.zh: 但由于它采用共享协议，因此所有这些社区都可以连接在一起。

sentences.en: You can go to a place like Bluesky and get all your notifications in one place.
sentences.zh: 您可以前往 Bluesky 这样的地方，并在一处获取所有通知。

sentences.en: You can see what’s going on across everything.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到一切发生的事情。

sentences.en: You just need one login, one place to check, but you still have the independence and the identity of these individual communities.
sentences.zh: 您只需要一次登录，在一个地方进行检查，但您仍然拥有这些单独社区的独立性和身份。

blocks.html_en: That is something that no other platform can do right now. You’re either on the large platform owned and controlled place, or you run your own and you’re a little siloed. We think we can solve that. We see the energy behind this idea and the number of things people are already prototyping is very palpable.

sentences.en: That is something that no other platform can do right now.
sentences.zh: 这是目前其他平台无法做到的。

sentences.en: You’re either on the large platform owned and controlled place, or you run your own and you’re a little siloed.
sentences.zh: 你要么在大型平台拥有和控制的地方，要么你运行自己的地方，你有点孤立。

sentences.en: We think we can solve that.
sentences.zh: 我们认为我们可以解决这个问题。

sentences.en: We see the energy behind this idea and the number of things people are already prototyping is very palpable.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了这个想法背后的能量，人们已经制作原型的东西的数量是非常明显的。

blocks.html_en: I have to ask you the other Decoder question because I’m very curious where this idea came from and how you decided to bet on it. How do you make decisions? What’s your framework for making decisions?

sentences.en: I have to ask you the other Decoder question because I’m very curious where this idea came from and how you decided to bet on it.
sentences.zh: 我必须问你另一个解码器问题，因为我很好奇这个想法从何而来以及你如何决定押注它。

sentences.en: How do you make decisions?
sentences.zh: 你如何做决定？

sentences.en: What’s your framework for making decisions?
sentences.zh: 你的决策框架是什么？

blocks.html_en: I already talked a little bit earlier about the reversible and irreversible decisions. The hardest thing about running any project is that, especially if it’s successful, it’s just an endless flow of things you have to prioritize and decide on. I find you could make that a lot less daunting and exhausting if you move a lot of decisions into this category of “they’re not that big a deal.” Let’s make it easy to experiment and reverse things, and really only focus on the truly long-term impactful things that we have to get right.

sentences.en: I already talked a little bit earlier about the reversible and irreversible decisions.
sentences.zh: 我之前已经谈到了可逆和不可逆的决定。

sentences.en: The hardest thing about running any project is that, especially if it’s successful, it’s just an endless flow of things you have to prioritize and decide on.
sentences.zh: 运行任何项目最困难的事情是，尤其是如果它成功了，它只是一个无穷无尽的事情，你必须优先考虑并做出决定。

sentences.en: I find you could make that a lot less daunting and exhausting if you move a lot of decisions into this category of “they’re not that big a deal.”
sentences.zh: 我发现，如果你把很多决定都归入“它们没什么大不了的”这一类，你就可以让这件事变得不那么令人畏惧和疲惫。

sentences.en: Let’s make it easy to experiment and reverse things, and really only focus on the truly long-term impactful things that we have to get right.
sentences.zh: 让我们能够轻松地进行实验和扭转事物，并且真正只关注我们必须做对的真正具有长期影响的事情。

blocks.html_en: You have this lightness or almost playfulness about some of these things, where it’s just not that big a deal. Let’s just try something. Let’s be creative and improvisational about it. This is a lot of how Automattic runs. I actually credit a lot of that to Matt Mullenweg’s approach to first running an open-source project. Inside Automattic, there are a lot of jazz analogies because Matt started out as a jazz musician. Just this improvisational, “don’t take it so seriously if you don’t have to.”

sentences.en: You have this lightness or almost playfulness about some of these things, where it’s just not that big a deal.
sentences.zh: 你对其中一些事情有一种轻松或近乎俏皮的态度，其实这没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: Let’s just try something.
sentences.zh: 让我们尝试一下。

sentences.en: Let’s be creative and improvisational about it.
sentences.zh: 让我们发挥创意和即兴发挥吧。

sentences.en: This is a lot of how Automattic runs.
sentences.zh: Automattic 的大部分运行方式都是如此。

sentences.en: I actually credit a lot of that to Matt Mullenweg’s approach to first running an open-source project.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我将这很大程度上归功于 Matt Mullenweg 首先运行开源项目的方法。

sentences.en: Inside Automattic, there are a lot of jazz analogies because Matt started out as a jazz musician.
sentences.zh: 在 Automattic 内部，有很多爵士乐类比，因为 Matt 最初是一名爵士音乐家。

sentences.en: Just this improvisational, “don’t take it so seriously if you don’t have to.”
sentences.zh: 就这么即兴发挥，“如非必要，别太当真。”

blocks.html_en: There are very serious decisions we have to make as well. For those, I like spending a lot of one-on-one time with the leaders, and then gathering and going through the list and talking through the trade-offs. Making sure that at least in a good cadence, monthly or maybe quarterly, we go through and make those hard trade-off decisions and don’t leave the room until we say, “No, we’re only doing these two things on the important list. We can’t do everything. Let’s voice all the ideas, but get to agreement on the few things we’re trying to get done. If we get those done, then we’re actually in good shape and we keep making forward progress.” That’s the ongoing flow that we go through, and it seems to be working.

sentences.en: There are very serious decisions we have to make as well.
sentences.zh: 我们还必须做出非常严肃的决定。

sentences.en: For those, I like spending a lot of one-on-one time with the leaders, and then gathering and going through the list and talking through the trade-offs.
sentences.zh: 对于这些，我喜欢花大量的一对一的时间与领导者交谈，然后收集并浏览清单并讨论权衡。

sentences.en: Making sure that at least in a good cadence, monthly or maybe quarterly, we go through and make those hard trade-off decisions and don’t leave the room until we say, “No, we’re only doing these two things on the important list.
sentences.zh: 确保至少以良好的节奏，每月或每季度，我们仔细考虑并做出艰难的权衡决定，直到我们说：“不，我们只做重要清单上的这两件事。

sentences.en: We can’t do everything.
sentences.zh: 我们无法包办一切。

sentences.en: Let’s voice all the ideas, but get to agreement on the few things we’re trying to get done.
sentences.zh: 让我们说出所有的想法，但就我们想要完成的几件事达成一致。

sentences.en: If we get those done, then we’re actually in good shape and we keep making forward progress.”
sentences.zh: 如果我们完成了这些，那么我们实际上处于良好状态，并且我们不断取得进展。”

sentences.en: That’s the ongoing flow that we go through, and it seems to be working.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们正在经历的流程，而且它似乎正在发挥作用。

blocks.html_en: I have to call out an email I got from a listener, ex-Amazon, who said, “Everyone always comes on your show and talks about reversible decisions and irreversible decisions. And I just want to point out that if you have enough money and time, every decision is reversible.” And I said, “Yeah, that’s right. Especially at Amazon scale, that’s certainly right.” What’s the line for you? What makes the decision irreversible? How much money and how much time does it take to reverse it?

sentences.en: I have to call out an email I got from a listener, ex-Amazon, who said, “Everyone always comes on your show and talks about reversible decisions and irreversible decisions.
sentences.zh: 我必须调出一封来自亚马逊前听众的电子邮件，他说：“每个人总是出现在你的节目中，谈论可逆的决定和不可逆的决定。

sentences.en: And I just want to point out that if you have enough money and time, every decision is reversible.”
sentences.zh: 我只是想指出，如果你有足够的金钱和时间，每一个决定都是可以逆转的。”

sentences.en: And I said, “Yeah, that’s right.
sentences.zh: 我说：“是的，没错。

sentences.en: Especially at Amazon scale, that’s certainly right.”
sentences.zh: 尤其是在亚马逊规模上，这当然是正确的。”

sentences.en: What’s the line for you?
sentences.zh: 你的线路是什么？

sentences.en: What makes the decision irreversible?
sentences.zh: 是什么让这个决定变得不可逆转？

sentences.en: How much money and how much time does it take to reverse it?
sentences.zh: 需要多少钱、多少时间才能逆转？

blocks.html_en: To me, it’s less about the money. It’s more the time. Some things just take years to unwind. I think anything that has – let’s call it a five-year time horizon, where it’d be really painful to change course. Or maybe on the positive framing, it’s more like, “If we get this right, we don’t have to think about it again for five years.” That’s the category of things where – people talk a lot about, for example, with startups, it’s your investors. Especially early on, the first investors you work with are going to be with you for five or 10 years. And that’s a pretty big decision. You shouldn’t just take the first check that comes along. You should really think that through because I’ve lived that.

sentences.en: To me, it’s less about the money.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这与钱无关。

sentences.en: It’s more the time.
sentences.zh: 时间多了。

sentences.en: Some things just take years to unwind.
sentences.zh: 有些事情需要数年时间才能平复。

sentences.en: I think anything that has – let’s call it a five-year time horizon, where it’d be really painful to change course.
sentences.zh: 我认为任何事情——让我们称之为五年的时间范围，改变方向都会非常痛苦。

sentences.en: Or maybe on the positive framing, it’s more like, “If we get this right, we don’t have to think about it again for five years.”
sentences.zh: 或者也许从积极的角度来看，它更像是，“如果我们做对了，我们五年内就不必再考虑它了。”

sentences.en: That’s the category of things where – people talk a lot about, for example, with startups, it’s your investors.
sentences.zh: 这是人们经常谈论的一类事情，例如，对于初创公司来说，这是你的投资者。

sentences.en: Especially early on, the first investors you work with are going to be with you for five or 10 years.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在早期，与你合作的第一批投资者将陪伴你五年或十年。

sentences.en: And that’s a pretty big decision.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当大的决定。

sentences.en: You shouldn’t just take the first check that comes along.
sentences.zh: 您不应该只接受第一张支票。

sentences.en: You should really think that through because I’ve lived that.
sentences.zh: 你真的应该仔细考虑一下，因为我就经历过这样的事情。

blocks.html_en: True has invested in 500 startups over the last 20 years, and we’ve seen every possible way that that plays out. That’s a good thing to really pay attention to early on, not just rush. Early in my career, I was like, “I just need money. Just give me a check and I’ll keep building. I just want to build things.” That’s an example of the timeframe where I feel like it’s really nice when it just works for several years. You [don’t] have to go back and invest more time, more money to reverse something.

sentences.en: True has invested in 500 startups over the last 20 years, and we’ve seen every possible way that that plays out.
sentences.zh: True 在过去 20 年里投资了 500 家初创公司，我们已经看到了一切可能的结果。

sentences.en: That’s a good thing to really pay attention to early on, not just rush.
sentences.zh: 尽早真正注意这一点是一件好事，而不仅仅是着急。

sentences.en: Early in my career, I was like, “I just need money.

sentences.en: Just give me a check and I’ll keep building.

sentences.en: I just want to build things.”
sentences.zh: 我只是想建造一些东西。”

sentences.en: That’s an example of the timeframe where I feel like it’s really nice when it just works for several years.
sentences.zh: 这是一个时间范围的例子，我觉得当它只工作几年时真的很好。

sentences.en: You [don’t] have to go back and invest more time, more money to reverse something.
sentences.zh: 你[不必]必须回去投入更多的时间、更多的金钱来扭转局面。

blocks.html_en: So I want to put two decisions in practice here. And your framing here is perfect for this question. You decided to be the CEO of Bluesky, to become the permanent CEO of Bluesky. You’re calling that a 10-year decision, right? It’s in your note. We’ve talked about it here. How did you make that decision? Did they come to you and say, “You’re going to be the CEO now. Sorry, we’re stripping the title away”? Did you have to write a memo? How did that all happen?

sentences.en: So I want to put two decisions in practice here.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在这里付诸实践两个决定。

sentences.en: And your framing here is perfect for this question.
sentences.zh: 你这里的框架非常适合这个问题。

sentences.en: You decided to be the CEO of Bluesky, to become the permanent CEO of Bluesky.
sentences.zh: 你决定成为蓝天的CEO，成为蓝天的永久CEO。

sentences.en: You’re calling that a 10-year decision, right?
sentences.zh: 你称这是一个十年的决定，对吗？

sentences.en: It’s in your note.
sentences.zh: 就在你的笔记里。

sentences.en: We’ve talked about it here.
sentences.zh: 我们已经在这里讨论过了。

sentences.en: How did you make that decision?
sentences.zh: 你是如何做出这个决定的？

sentences.en: Did they come to you and say, “You’re going to be the CEO now.
sentences.zh: 他们是否来找你说：“你现在要担任首席执行官了。

sentences.en: Sorry, we’re stripping the title away”?
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我们要取消标题”？

sentences.en: Did you have to write a memo?
sentences.zh: 需要写备忘录吗？

sentences.en: How did that all happen?
sentences.zh: 这一切是怎么发生的？

blocks.html_en: It was a gradual process. The job is great. The team is great. The mission is what I want to work on for the next 10 years. So that was not a hard decision. It was really that I already had a job, and just figuring out a way to make those two pieces work together and to make a transition work. From early on, the Bluesky team and board said, “We think this is working really well. Can we make this permanent?” It was probably a couple months of just working through how a transition would work.

sentences.en: It was a gradual process.
sentences.zh: 这是一个渐进的过程。

sentences.en: The job is great.
sentences.zh: 这项工作很棒。

sentences.en: The team is great.
sentences.zh: 团队很棒。

sentences.en: The mission is what I want to work on for the next 10 years.
sentences.zh: 这个使命是我未来10年想要努力实现的目标。

sentences.en: So that was not a hard decision.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是一个艰难的决定。

sentences.en: It was really that I already had a job, and just figuring out a way to make those two pieces work together and to make a transition work.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我已经有了一份工作，只是想办法让这两部分一起工作并进行过渡。

sentences.en: From early on, the Bluesky team and board said, “We think this is working really well.
sentences.zh: Bluesky 团队和董事会从一开始就表示：“我们认为这非常有效。

sentences.en: Can we make this permanent?”
sentences.zh: 我们可以让这成为永久性的吗？”

sentences.en: It was probably a couple months of just working through how a transition would work.
sentences.zh: 可能花了几个月的时间来研究如何进行过渡。

blocks.html_en: So you were the interim CEO for two months, and you spent two months figuring out how the transition worked and then you became the permanent CEO?

sentences.en: So you were the interim CEO for two months, and you spent two months figuring out how the transition worked and then you became the permanent CEO?
sentences.zh: 那么，您担任了两个月的临时首席执行官，并花了两个月的时间来弄清楚过渡是如何进行的，然后您就成为了永久首席执行官？

blocks.html_en: Yeah. Yeah, that sounds about right.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, that sounds about right.
sentences.zh: 是的，听起来不错。

blocks.html_en: It’s quite a timeline. The second one, maybe much more importantly is, “We’re going to make this big bet on private communities. We’re going to extend the protocol.” Logically, you’re going to have to extend the Bluesky app itself. You’re going to have to make a big bet on both the standard itself and how the consumer app will work. I would say, and maybe this is too reductive, the community on the Bluesky app does not like change, so you’re going to have to endure some change with them. “This is a bet. This is a big decision. This has to be the future of the protocol, the future of the ATmosphere.” How did you make that decision, and what made you convinced that it was the right one?

sentences.en: It’s quite a timeline.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当长的时间表。

sentences.en: The second one, maybe much more importantly is, “We’re going to make this big bet on private communities.
sentences.zh: 第二个也许更重要的是，“我们将在私人社区上下大赌注。

sentences.en: We’re going to extend the protocol.”
sentences.zh: 我们将扩展该协议。”

sentences.en: Logically, you’re going to have to extend the Bluesky app itself.
sentences.zh: 从逻辑上讲，您将必须扩展 Bluesky 应用程序本身。

sentences.en: You’re going to have to make a big bet on both the standard itself and how the consumer app will work.
sentences.zh: 您将不得不在标准本身以及消费者应用程序的工作方式上下很大的赌注。

sentences.en: I would say, and maybe this is too reductive, the community on the Bluesky app does not like change, so you’re going to have to endure some change with them.
sentences.zh: 我想说，也许这太简单了，Bluesky 应用程序上的社区不喜欢改变，所以你将不得不忍受他们的一些改变。

sentences.en: “This is a bet.
sentences.zh: “这是一个赌注。

sentences.en: This is a big decision.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大决定。

sentences.en: This has to be the future of the protocol, the future of the ATmosphere.”
sentences.zh: 这必须是协议的未来，ATmosphere 的未来。”

sentences.en: How did you make that decision, and what made you convinced that it was the right one?
sentences.zh: 您是如何做出这一决定的？是什么让您确信这是正确的？

blocks.html_en: The decision to extend the protocol has been underway. A year or two years ago, or maybe even from the very beginnings of the protocol, people said, “What are we going to do about private data?” So that’s been building, and it’s natural. Once people start building on your protocol, it’s the first question. “This is great, but I do have some private data.”

sentences.en: The decision to extend the protocol has been underway.
sentences.zh: 延长协议的决定正在进行中。

sentences.en: A year or two years ago, or maybe even from the very beginnings of the protocol, people said, “What are we going to do about private data?”
sentences.zh: 一两年前，或者甚至从协议一开始，人们就说：“我们该如何处理私人数据？”

sentences.en: So that’s been building, and it’s natural.
sentences.zh: 所以这一直在建立，这是很自然的。

sentences.en: Once people start building on your protocol, it’s the first question.
sentences.zh: 一旦人们开始构建你的协议，这就是第一个问题。

sentences.en: “This is great, but I do have some private data.”
sentences.zh: “这很棒，但我确实有一些私人数据。”

blocks.html_en: Even inside the Bluesky app, we have DMs. Those aren’t on the protocol. We don’t want those out in the public. We have features inside the app that we had to build off protocol because it couldn’t support private data. So we have our own use cases. We got lots of them. That’s an obvious “we just have to do it.” How it affects the community, that’s what our app team is working through right now. One of the things that I feel like we’ve gotten better at in the last few months is to do that out in the open.

sentences.en: Even inside the Bluesky app, we have DMs.
sentences.zh: 即使在 Bluesky 应用程序内，我们也有 DM。

sentences.en: Those aren’t on the protocol.
sentences.zh: 这些不在协议上。

sentences.en: We don’t want those out in the public.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望这些被公开。

sentences.en: We have features inside the app that we had to build off protocol because it couldn’t support private data.
sentences.zh: 我们的应用程序内部有一些功能，我们必须根据协议构建这些功能，因为它无法支持私有数据。

sentences.en: So we have our own use cases.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有自己的用例。

sentences.en: We got lots of them.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多。

sentences.en: That’s an obvious “we just have to do it.”
sentences.zh: 这显然是“我们必须这么做”。

sentences.en: How it affects the community, that’s what our app team is working through right now.
sentences.zh: 它如何影响社区，这就是我们的应用程序团队目前正在解决的问题。

sentences.en: One of the things that I feel like we’ve gotten better at in the last few months is to do that out in the open.
sentences.zh: 我觉得过去几个月我们做得更好的一件事就是公开地这样做。

blocks.html_en: Alex Benzer, who’s our head of product, who makes those decisions around what goes in the app and what doesn’t, has been posting about it and inviting feedback and saying, “Look, this is coming. What do you think? What kind of communities do you want? Do you want them? How similar should they be to the current app? How different?” I think we have 500 people who’ve signed up to give us feedback. We’re going through user interviews.

sentences.en: Alex Benzer, who’s our head of product, who makes those decisions around what goes in the app and what doesn’t, has been posting about it and inviting feedback and saying, “Look, this is coming.
sentences.zh: Alex Benzer 是我们的产品主管，负责决定应用程序中包含哪些内容和不包含哪些内容，他一直在发布相关信息并征求反馈，并表示：“看，这即将到来。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你怎么认为？

sentences.en: What kind of communities do you want?
sentences.zh: 你想要什么样的社区？

sentences.en: Do you want them?
sentences.zh: 你想要它们吗？

sentences.en: How similar should they be to the current app?
sentences.zh: 它们与当前应用程序应该有多相似？

sentences.en: How different?”
sentences.zh: 有什么不同？

sentences.en: I think we have 500 people who’ve signed up to give us feedback.
sentences.zh: 我想我们已经有 500 人报名向我们提供反馈。

sentences.en: We’re going through user interviews.
sentences.zh: 我们正在进行用户访谈。

blocks.html_en: People are already building communities on Bluesky actually because we have this functionality where people can make custom feeds. One of the huge differences in Bluesky is no algorithms. You get to make your own. You can plug in your own. People have made over 100,000 feeds. Some of those are really communities themselves. There are things like BookSky and AstroSky, where it’s just communities of people talking about a certain topic within a custom feed. People have taken what we have to bend it into a community shape.

sentences.en: People are already building communities on Bluesky actually because we have this functionality where people can make custom feeds.
sentences.zh: 实际上，人们已经在 Bluesky 上建立了社区，因为我们拥有人们可以制作自定义提要的功能。

sentences.en: One of the huge differences in Bluesky is no algorithms.
sentences.zh: Bluesky 的巨大差异之一是没有算法。

sentences.en: You get to make your own.
sentences.zh: 你可以自己制作。

sentences.en: You can plug in your own.
sentences.zh: 您可以自己插入。

sentences.en: People have made over 100,000 feeds.
sentences.zh: 人们已经制作了超过 100,000 个提要。

sentences.en: Some of those are really communities themselves.
sentences.zh: 其中一些本身就是真正的社区。

sentences.en: There are things like BookSky and AstroSky, where it’s just communities of people talking about a certain topic within a custom feed.
sentences.zh: 像 BookSky 和 ​​AstroSky 这样的东西，只是人们在自定义提要中讨论某个主题的社区。

sentences.en: People have taken what we have to bend it into a community shape.
sentences.zh: 人们已经把我们所拥有的东西变成了社区的形状。

blocks.html_en: It’s already happening on a network. That makes it a lot less scary. It’s not like we’re going to stop one thing and pivot somewhere else. We’re just doing more of a thing that some users are already doing. I think we can do it in a way that doesn’t disrupt. If you never want to join a private community, you don’t have to. Bluesky the app as it stands today isn’t going to change. The public part of it is popular, it’s growing. So we’re not going to mess with that.

sentences.en: It’s already happening on a network.
sentences.zh: 这已经在网络上发生了。

sentences.en: That makes it a lot less scary.
sentences.zh: 这让它不那么可怕了。

sentences.en: It’s not like we’re going to stop one thing and pivot somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是要停止一件事然后转向其他地方。

sentences.en: We’re just doing more of a thing that some users are already doing.
sentences.zh: 我们只是做了更多一些用户已经在做的事情。

sentences.en: I think we can do it in a way that doesn’t disrupt.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们可以以一种不造成干扰的方式来做到这一点。

sentences.en: If you never want to join a private community, you don’t have to.
sentences.zh: 如果您不想加入私人社区，则不必这样做。

sentences.en: Bluesky the app as it stands today isn’t going to change.
sentences.zh: Bluesky 目前的应用程序不会改变。

sentences.en: The public part of it is popular, it’s growing.
sentences.zh: 它的公共部分很受欢迎，并且正在增长。

sentences.en: So we’re not going to mess with that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不会搞乱它。

blocks.html_en: Let me ask you about Bluesky the app not changing, because I think that’s the thing that I’m poking at. It feels like every other social network evolves into a crab. Everything is evolving into TikTok. We can see it happening every single day. Meta today announced a test in which the big blue Facebook app will open for some set of users into full-screen video. “Screw it. We’re just going to turn Facebook into TikTok.” Everything heads in that direction. X has headed in that direction. That’s the competition, and maybe that’s the thing the market wants.

sentences.en: Let me ask you about Bluesky the app not changing, because I think that’s the thing that I’m poking at.
sentences.zh: 让我问一下 Bluesky 这个应用程序没有改变的情况，因为我认为这就是我正在探讨的事情。

sentences.en: It feels like every other social network evolves into a crab.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像所有其他社交网络都演变成一只螃蟹。

sentences.en: Everything is evolving into TikTok.
sentences.zh: 一切都在演变为 TikTok。

sentences.en: We can see it happening every single day.
sentences.zh: 我们每天都能看到这样的事情发生。

sentences.en: Meta today announced a test in which the big blue Facebook app will open for some set of users into full-screen video.
sentences.zh: Meta 今天宣布了一项测试，蓝色的 Facebook 应用程序将为某些用户打开全屏视频。

sentences.en: “Screw it.
sentences.zh: “管他的。

sentences.en: We’re just going to turn Facebook into TikTok.”
sentences.zh: 我们只是要把 Facebook 变成 TikTok。”

sentences.en: Everything heads in that direction.
sentences.zh: 一切都朝着那个方向发展。

sentences.en: X has headed in that direction.
sentences.zh: X已经朝这个方向前进了。

sentences.en: That’s the competition, and maybe that’s the thing the market wants.
sentences.zh: 这就是竞争，也许这就是市场想要的。

blocks.html_en: You’re saying, “We’re going to build private data. We’ll have a more Reddit-like experience.” Bluesky may be the last really text-first social platform of its kind that exists. Do you feel that pull into different directions, into different formats? Because that’s a thing that your user base also pushes against.

sentences.en: You’re saying, “We’re going to build private data.
sentences.zh: 你是说，“我们要建立私人数据。

sentences.en: We’ll have a more Reddit-like experience.”
sentences.zh: 我们将获得更像 Reddit 的体验。”

sentences.en: Bluesky may be the last really text-first social platform of its kind that exists.
sentences.zh: Bluesky 可能是同类中最后一个真正以文本为先的社交平台。

sentences.en: Do you feel that pull into different directions, into different formats?
sentences.zh: 你是否觉得这会导致不同的方向、不同的形式？

sentences.en: Because that’s a thing that your user base also pushes against.
sentences.zh: 因为这也是你的用户群所反对的。

blocks.html_en: This is the beauty of an open protocol. Let somebody else build the TikTok of AT Proto. Let somebody else go push into new formats. We’re perfectly happy with a text-first, microblogging network. We love it. Honestly, I’m glad if others are chasing off in other directions because we like what we have.

sentences.en: This is the beauty of an open protocol.
sentences.zh: 这就是开放协议的美妙之处。
