sentences.en: Let somebody else build the TikTok of AT Proto.
sentences.zh: 让别人来构建 AT Proto 的 TikTok。

sentences.en: Let somebody else go push into new formats.
sentences.zh: 让其他人去推动新的格式。

sentences.en: We’re perfectly happy with a text-first, microblogging network.
sentences.zh: 我们对文本优先的微博网络非常满意。

sentences.en: We love it.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢它。

sentences.en: Honestly, I’m glad if others are chasing off in other directions because we like what we have.
sentences.zh: 老实说，如果其他人因为喜欢我们所拥有的而转向其他方向，我很高兴。

blocks.html_en: We talked earlier about traffic. A lot of these other networks, as you know… You’ve coined the term Google Zero right there. All these walled gardens, all these other platforms are getting more and more walled. They say, “Once we’re open enough to attract an audience, and then once you’re here, we’re not going to let you go. We’re just going to keep trying to find ways to keep you in there.”

sentences.en: We talked earlier about traffic.
sentences.zh: 我们之前讨论过交通。

sentences.en: A lot of these other networks, as you know…
sentences.zh: 如您所知，还有很多其他网络......

sentences.en: You’ve coined the term Google Zero right there.
sentences.zh: 您在那里创造了“谷歌零”这个词。

sentences.en: All these walled gardens, all these other platforms are getting more and more walled.
sentences.zh: 所有这些有围墙的花园，所有这些其他平台都变得越来越有围墙。

sentences.en: They say, “Once we’re open enough to attract an audience, and then once you’re here, we’re not going to let you go.
sentences.zh: 他们说：“一旦我们足够开放以吸引观众，那么一旦你来到这里，我们就不会放你走。

sentences.en: We’re just going to keep trying to find ways to keep you in there.”
sentences.zh: 我们将继续努力寻找让你留在那里的方法。”

blocks.html_en: Bluesky’s the opposite. Because of the protocol, it’s locked open by default. We couldn’t keep you in it even if we wanted to. We want people to build other apps and experiment with other things. We want people to find great content on Bluesky and leave. We’re still a place where we don’t downrank links. We love sending traffic to people. We send two million clicks a day to publishers. We’re the number-one referrer to a bunch of publishers, and we want to do more of that. We love the way that the open web works and people come to Bluesky to connect, to learn, to have fun, and then to find interesting things to go to. There’s no way we’re going to change that.

sentences.en: Bluesky’s the opposite.
sentences.zh: 蓝天则相反。

sentences.en: Because of the protocol, it’s locked open by default.
sentences.zh: 由于协议的原因，它默认是锁定打开的。

sentences.en: We couldn’t keep you in it even if we wanted to.
sentences.zh: 即使我们愿意，我们也无法让你留在其中。

sentences.en: We want people to build other apps and experiment with other things.
sentences.zh: 我们希望人们构建其他应用程序并尝试其他东西。

sentences.en: We want people to find great content on Bluesky and leave.
sentences.zh: 我们希望人们在 Bluesky 上找到精彩内容并离开。

sentences.en: We’re still a place where we don’t downrank links.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然是一个不会降低链接排名的地方。

sentences.en: We love sending traffic to people.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢向人们发送流量。

sentences.en: We send two million clicks a day to publishers.
sentences.zh: 我们每天向发布商发送 200 万次点击。

sentences.en: We’re the number-one referrer to a bunch of publishers, and we want to do more of that.
sentences.zh: 我们是众多出版商的第一推荐人，我们希望在这方面做得更多。

sentences.en: We love the way that the open web works and people come to Bluesky to connect, to learn, to have fun, and then to find interesting things to go to.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢开放网络的运作方式，人们来到 Bluesky 是为了联系、学习、享受乐趣，然后寻找有趣的事物。

sentences.en: There’s no way we’re going to change that.
sentences.zh: 我们无法改变这一点。

blocks.html_en: I’m curious, if someone wants to build the TikTok of the ATmosphere, is there a bunch of protocol-level work that needs to be done to support it? I know there are attempts to do this. Skylight, I think, is a TikTok-like app on the ATmosphere. There are others. But all of your technical innovation on the standard itself is pointed at text. I’m wondering if there’s something you need to do to be better at video to compete with what all of the closed platforms are chasing at a much larger scale.

sentences.en: I’m curious, if someone wants to build the TikTok of the ATmosphere, is there a bunch of protocol-level work that needs to be done to support it?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，如果有人想打造ATmosphere的TikTok，是不是需要做一堆协议层面的工作来支撑？

sentences.en: I know there are attempts to do this.
sentences.zh: 我知道有人尝试这样做。

sentences.en: Skylight, I think, is a TikTok-like app on the ATmosphere.
sentences.zh: 我认为 Skylight 是 ATmosphere 上一款类似 TikTok 的应用程序。

sentences.en: There are others.
sentences.zh: 还有其他的。

sentences.en: But all of your technical innovation on the standard itself is pointed at text.
sentences.zh: 但你们对标准本身的所有技术创新都是针对文本的。

sentences.en: I’m wondering if there’s something you need to do to be better at video to compete with what all of the closed platforms are chasing at a much larger scale.
sentences.zh: 我想知道是否需要做一些事情才能在视频方面做得更好，以便与所有封闭平台在更大范围内追逐的目标进行竞争。

blocks.html_en: No, I think at the protocol level, it’s easy to do. You can define your own records on the protocol. Yes, ours are text-focused or posts, they’re follows, they’re likes, things like that. But there are already people publishing all kinds of different things within a protocol. I saw yesterday that somebody’s publishing a patent database onto AT Proto, so everybody else can just tap into that patent information. There’s somebody who’s publishing the health data off of their Apple Watch onto their PDS. So they’re just live-streaming their health data onto the protocol. People are putting out all kinds of things.

sentences.en: No, I think at the protocol level, it’s easy to do.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为在协议层面，这很容易做到。

sentences.en: You can define your own records on the protocol.
sentences.zh: 您可以在协议上定义自己的记录。

sentences.en: Yes, ours are text-focused or posts, they’re follows, they’re likes, things like that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们的内容是以文本或帖子为中心的，它们是关注的，它们是喜欢的，诸如此类的东西。

sentences.en: But there are already people publishing all kinds of different things within a protocol.
sentences.zh: 但已经有人在协议中发布各种不同的东西。

sentences.en: I saw yesterday that somebody’s publishing a patent database onto AT Proto, so everybody else can just tap into that patent information.
sentences.zh: 我昨天看到有人在 AT Proto 上发布了一个专利数据库，这样其他人就可以利用该专利信息。

sentences.en: There’s somebody who’s publishing the health data off of their Apple Watch onto their PDS.
sentences.zh: 有人将 Apple Watch 上的健康数据发布到 PDS 上。

sentences.en: So they’re just live-streaming their health data onto the protocol.
sentences.zh: 所以他们只是将他们的健康数据实时传输到协议上。

sentences.en: People are putting out all kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 人们正在推出各种各样的东西。

blocks.html_en: The protocol can be used for anything. What’s harder is that you need people there, so that when you build the next TikTok on AT Proto and you launch that app, it launches into millions and millions of people who are already there. That’s what we’re working on, to just keep getting more and more people onto the ATmosphere so that you don’t have that cold start problem as a new developer where you want enough people. Eventually our 10-year goal is a billion people on AT Proto. You don’t need a billion to have success with a new product, but you need a critical mass so that when people show up, then they ask, “Oh, where are my friends?”

sentences.en: The protocol can be used for anything.
sentences.zh: 该协议可以用于任何事情。

sentences.en: What’s harder is that you need people there, so that when you build the next TikTok on AT Proto and you launch that app, it launches into millions and millions of people who are already there.
sentences.zh: 更困难的是你需要那里的人，这样当你在 AT Proto 上构建下一个 TikTok 并启动该应用程序时，它就会向数百万已经在那里的人推出。

sentences.en: That’s what we’re working on, to just keep getting more and more people onto the ATmosphere so that you don’t have that cold start problem as a new developer where you want enough people.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们正在努力的方向，不断吸引越来越多的人加入 ATmosphere，这样作为新开发人员，您就不会遇到冷启动问题，因为您需要足够的人员。

sentences.en: Eventually our 10-year goal is a billion people on AT Proto.
sentences.zh: 最终我们的 10 年目标是 AT Proto 上有 10 亿人。

sentences.en: You don’t need a billion to have success with a new product, but you need a critical mass so that when people show up, then they ask, “Oh, where are my friends?”
sentences.zh: 你不需要十亿美元才能让新产品取得成功，但你需要足够多的人，这样当人们出现时，他们就会问：“哦，我的朋友在哪里？”

blocks.html_en: This is the dynamic that I’m really interested in with the Bluesky app and then the protocol itself. It’s no secret that I’ve been talking about federating The Verge for like a hundred years, and we’re going to do it one of these days. One of the issues here is we publish in a lot of formats in a lot of different places. If I just immediately federate The Verge tomorrow, we have a lot of video. Where’s the video going to go? It’s going to go out on the network. Maybe I can convince a lot of people to download a Verge app and they’ll see a bunch of stuff in it, and that would be great.

sentences.en: This is the dynamic that I’m really interested in with the Bluesky app and then the protocol itself.
sentences.zh: 这是我真正感兴趣的 Bluesky 应用程序以及协议本身的动态。

sentences.en: It’s no secret that I’ve been talking about federating The Verge for like a hundred years, and we’re going to do it one of these days.
sentences.zh: 一百年来我一直在谈论联合 The Verge，这已经不是什么秘密了，总有一天我们会这么做。

sentences.en: One of the issues here is we publish in a lot of formats in a lot of different places.
sentences.zh: 这里的问题之一是我们在很多不同的地方以多种格式发布。

sentences.en: If I just immediately federate The Verge tomorrow, we have a lot of video.
sentences.zh: 如果我明天立即联合 The Verge，我们就会有很多视频。

sentences.en: Where’s the video going to go?
sentences.zh: 视频会去哪里？

sentences.en: It’s going to go out on the network.
sentences.zh: 它将在网络上传播。

sentences.en: Maybe I can convince a lot of people to download a Verge app and they’ll see a bunch of stuff in it, and that would be great.
sentences.zh: 也许我可以说服很多人下载 Verge 应用程序，他们会在其中看到很多东西，那就太好了。

blocks.html_en: But if what you’re describing is that Bluesky the app will be the entrance point for a lot of different people, and Bluesky the app has not prioritized video as part of the core part of the user experience – for any number of reasons why you might not prioritize video – then that part of the network won’t get that effect. It won’t get what feels like a network effect, which is, “Oh, there are lots of people here.” The way that if I federate The Verge, I’d say, “Look at all these great posts from other tech writers,” I could do that tomorrow.

sentences.en: But if what you’re describing is that Bluesky the app will be the entrance point for a lot of different people, and Bluesky the app has not prioritized video as part of the core part of the user experience – for any number of reasons why you might not prioritize video – then that part of the network won’t get that effect.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果您所描述的是 Bluesky 应用程序将成为许多不同人的入口点，并且 Bluesky 应用程序没有将视频作为用户体验核心部分的一部分（出于多种原因您可能不会优先考虑视频），那么网络的这一部分将不会达到这种效果。

sentences.en: It won’t get what feels like a network effect, which is, “Oh, there are lots of people here.”
sentences.zh: 它不会产生网络效应，即“哦，这里有很多人。”

sentences.en: The way that if I federate The Verge, I’d say, “Look at all these great posts from other tech writers,” I could do that tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 如果我联合 The Verge，我会说，“看看其他科技作家的所有这些精彩帖子”，我明天就可以这样做。

blocks.html_en: It’s almost easy to do. It’s easy to vibe-code that prototype, I will tell you. It’s hard to get it all the way to the finish line. That’s the dynamic. If you want Bluesky, the consumer app, to be the entry point to the diversity of the network, the app itself has to be diverse in a way that might dilute the app and make it lose its product market fit. How do you think about that back and forth?

sentences.en: It’s almost easy to do.
sentences.zh: 这几乎很容易做到。

sentences.en: It’s easy to vibe-code that prototype, I will tell you.
sentences.zh: 我会告诉你，对原型进行振动编码很容易。

sentences.en: It’s hard to get it all the way to the finish line.
sentences.zh: 想要一路到达终点线是很困难的。

sentences.en: That’s the dynamic.
sentences.zh: 这就是动态。

sentences.en: If you want Bluesky, the consumer app, to be the entry point to the diversity of the network, the app itself has to be diverse in a way that might dilute the app and make it lose its product market fit.
sentences.zh: 如果您希望消费者应用程序 Bluesky 成为网络多样性的切入点，那么该应用程序本身就必须具有多样性，这可能会稀释该应用程序并使其失去其产品市场契合度。

sentences.en: How do you think about that back and forth?
sentences.zh: 您如何看待这一来回？

blocks.html_en: I think what we’re seeing works well, and I’ll go back to the Standard Site example. If the other piece of content that’s not text is something that can show up inside a post, we call them link cards, and that could be a video. It could be a game. It could be something where somebody can post about it and say, “Hey, check out this new game.” Somebody can see it and then go there. That’s a perfect fit because then it fits our mode of how people discover things. But then when they want to engage with it, we send them off to that place.

sentences.en: I think what we’re seeing works well, and I’ll go back to the Standard Site example.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们所看到的效果很好，我将回到标准站点示例。

sentences.en: If the other piece of content that’s not text is something that can show up inside a post, we call them link cards, and that could be a video.
sentences.zh: 如果非文本的其他内容可以显示在帖子中，我们将其称为链接卡，这可能是视频。

sentences.en: It could be a game.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一场游戏。

sentences.en: It could be something where somebody can post about it and say, “Hey, check out this new game.”
sentences.zh: 可能有人可以发布相关内容并说：“嘿，看看这个新游戏。”

sentences.en: Somebody can see it and then go there.
sentences.zh: 有人可以看到它然后去那里。

sentences.en: That’s a perfect fit because then it fits our mode of how people discover things.
sentences.zh: 这是一个完美的契合，因为它符合我们人们发现事物的方式。

sentences.en: But then when they want to engage with it, we send them off to that place.
sentences.zh: 但当他们想要参与其中时，我们就会把他们送到那个地方。

blocks.html_en: Same with video. As long as somebody can embed it and promote it on our end, we’re not going to try and become a video network where we then say, “Oh, all video has to be watched on Bluesky.” No, no, no. Go off to The Verge, go somewhere else, go explore. I think Bluesky as an app is a great place to surface things and notify people of new things, but it does have to somehow fit inside the post. You can give people a preview essentially and say, “Okay, now go play this game. Go subscribe to this publication. Go donate to this cause.” That’s the kind of action we’re trying to surface for everybody else in the ATmosphere and then just send people off on their way.

sentences.en: Same with video.
sentences.zh: 与视频相同。

sentences.en: As long as somebody can embed it and promote it on our end, we’re not going to try and become a video network where we then say, “Oh, all video has to be watched on Bluesky.”
sentences.zh: 只要有人可以将其嵌入并在我们这边推广，我们就不会尝试成为一个视频网络，然后我们说：“哦，所有视频都必须在 Bluesky 上观看。”

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: Go off to The Verge, go somewhere else, go explore.
sentences.zh: 去The Verge，去别的地方，去探索。

sentences.en: I think Bluesky as an app is a great place to surface things and notify people of new things, but it does have to somehow fit inside the post.
sentences.zh: 我认为 Bluesky 作为一个应用程序是一个展示事物并通知人们新事物的好地方，但它确实必须以某种方式适合帖子。

sentences.en: You can give people a preview essentially and say, “Okay, now go play this game.
sentences.zh: 你基本上可以给人们一个预览，然后说：“好吧，现在去玩这个游戏。

sentences.en: Go subscribe to this publication.
sentences.zh: 去订阅这份出版物吧。

sentences.en: Go donate to this cause.”
sentences.zh: 去为这个事业捐款吧。”

sentences.en: That’s the kind of action we’re trying to surface for everybody else in the ATmosphere and then just send people off on their way.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们试图向大气层中的其他人展示的那种行动，然后让人们离开。

blocks.html_en: I want to ask you to compare your role at Bluesky to when you were the CEO of Automattic. These are big companies, or we want them to be big companies that operate on standards and protocols and the open web in different ways. At Bluesky, you control the standard itself. This is a very important piece of the puzzle that the standard is in development. And you’re making products on top of it and you want other people to build on top of the standard.

sentences.en: I want to ask you to compare your role at Bluesky to when you were the CEO of Automattic.
sentences.zh: 我想请您将您在 Bluesky 的角色与您担任 Automattic 首席执行官时的角色进行比较。

sentences.en: These are big companies, or we want them to be big companies that operate on standards and protocols and the open web in different ways.
sentences.zh: 这些都是大公司，或者我们希望他们成为以不同方式按照标准、协议和开放网络运营的大公司。

sentences.en: At Bluesky, you control the standard itself.
sentences.zh: 在 Bluesky，您可以控制标准本身。

sentences.en: This is a very important piece of the puzzle that the standard is in development.
sentences.zh: 这是该标准正在开发中的一个非常重要的难题。

sentences.en: And you’re making products on top of it and you want other people to build on top of the standard.
sentences.zh: 你在它的基础上生产产品，你希望其他人在标准的基础上构建。

blocks.html_en: A lot of people can say a lot of things about Automattic’s relationship to the web, but technically you don’t control the standard. And maybe it has enough scale so that the way Automattic does it becomes the way everyone else does it. But at Automattic, you didn’t make the browsers. You weren’t on the steering committees of the big standards in a way that allowed you to actually dictate what they were. You were making a web-server product that interacted with an ecosystem of other open products. Do you want Bluesky to get there where it’s just one player among many, or do you want to retain control of the standard too? And how do you think that’s different from how Automattic exists in the web ecosystem?

sentences.en: A lot of people can say a lot of things about Automattic’s relationship to the web, but technically you don’t control the standard.
sentences.zh: 关于 Automattic 与网络的关系，很多人可以说很多，但从技术上讲，你无法控制该标准。

sentences.en: And maybe it has enough scale so that the way Automattic does it becomes the way everyone else does it.
sentences.zh: 也许它有足够的规模，以至于 Automattic 的做法会成为其他人的做法。

sentences.en: But at Automattic, you didn’t make the browsers.
sentences.zh: 但在 Automattic，浏览器并不是你制造的。

sentences.en: You weren’t on the steering committees of the big standards in a way that allowed you to actually dictate what they were.
sentences.zh: 你并不是大标准指导委员会的成员，无法让你真正决定它们是什么。

sentences.en: You were making a web-server product that interacted with an ecosystem of other open products.
sentences.zh: 您正在制作一个与其他开放产品的生态系统进行交互的网络服务器产品。

sentences.en: Do you want Bluesky to get there where it’s just one player among many, or do you want to retain control of the standard too?
sentences.zh: 您是否希望 Bluesky 成为众多参与者中的一员，或者您也想保留对标准的控制权？

sentences.en: And how do you think that’s different from how Automattic exists in the web ecosystem?
sentences.zh: 您认为这与 Automattic 在网络生态系统中的存在有何不同？

blocks.html_en: We 100% do not want to control the standard at Bluesky. We are actually very actively doing everything in our power to divest control of it. First was to design the network in a way that if Bluesky goes down or goes away, the rest of the network is fine. That’s a big test case for us. It actually got tested a couple of months ago, not the way we had hoped, but we got a DDoS attack on the Bluesky network. A very, very massive one. It did take us down for several hours. Other parts of the network, like I mentioned Blacksky earlier, operated just fine, totally independently. That’s a big part. Just the practicality of it is, can other nodes in this network operate independently? Are there things left that Bluesky runs that everybody else is dependent on? And if so, what can we do to fix that?

sentences.en: We 100% do not want to control the standard at Bluesky.
sentences.zh: 我们100%不想控制Bluesky的标准。

sentences.en: We are actually very actively doing everything in our power to divest control of it.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我们正在非常积极地尽我们所能来放弃对其的控制。

sentences.en: First was to design the network in a way that if Bluesky goes down or goes away, the rest of the network is fine.
sentences.zh: 首先是设计网络，确保如果 Bluesky 出现故障或消失，网络的其余部分都可以正常工作。

sentences.en: That’s a big test case for us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们来说是一个很大的考验。

sentences.en: It actually got tested a couple of months ago, not the way we had hoped, but we got a DDoS attack on the Bluesky network.
sentences.zh: 它实际上在几个月前进行了测试，但与我们希望的方式不同，但我们在 Bluesky 网络上遭受了 DDoS 攻击。

sentences.en: A very, very massive one.
sentences.zh: 一个非常非常巨大的。

sentences.en: It did take us down for several hours.
sentences.zh: 它确实让我们失望了几个小时。

sentences.en: Other parts of the network, like I mentioned Blacksky earlier, operated just fine, totally independently.
sentences.zh: 网络的其他部分，就像我之前提到的 Blacksky 一样，运行得很好，完全独立。

sentences.en: That’s a big part.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很大的部分。

sentences.en: Just the practicality of it is, can other nodes in this network operate independently?
sentences.zh: 只是它的实用性在于，这个网络中的其他节点可以独立运行吗？

sentences.en: Are there things left that Bluesky runs that everybody else is dependent on?
sentences.zh: 是否还有其他人依赖 Bluesky 运营的业务？

sentences.en: And if so, what can we do to fix that?
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，我们可以做些什么来解决这个问题？

blocks.html_en: A big part of that, too, is that – this gets a little nerdy into the whole stack and the protocol – when people look at the design of this network and they like to find out, is it truly decentralized or not? There is one thing at the heart of it that absolutely no company should control, and that’s the identity directory, the lookup. When you log in your identity in the ATmosphere, where does that lookup actually happen? It’s like DNS on the web when somebody looks up a URL. We have been running that core directory, and we’re actually in the process of setting up a Swiss nonprofit with a separate board, a completely separate entity, to which we’ve handed over that directory. We’re in the process of handing over the domain to it. So that’s one example.

sentences.en: A big part of that, too, is that – this gets a little nerdy into the whole stack and the protocol – when people look at the design of this network and they like to find out, is it truly decentralized or not?
sentences.zh: 其中一个重要部分是——这让整个堆栈和协议变得有点书呆子气——当人们审视这个网络的设计时，他们想知道它是否真正去中心化？

sentences.en: There is one thing at the heart of it that absolutely no company should control, and that’s the identity directory, the lookup.
sentences.zh: 其核心有一件事情是任何公司绝对不应该控制的，那就是身份目录，即查找。

sentences.en: When you log in your identity in the ATmosphere, where does that lookup actually happen?
sentences.zh: 当您在 ATmosphere 中登录您的身份时，该查找实际上发生在哪里？

sentences.en: It’s like DNS on the web when somebody looks up a URL.
sentences.zh: 当有人查找 URL 时，这就像网络上的 DNS 一样。

sentences.en: We have been running that core directory, and we’re actually in the process of setting up a Swiss nonprofit with a separate board, a completely separate entity, to which we’ve handed over that directory.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在运行这个核心目录，实际上我们正在建立一个瑞士非营利组织，拥有一个单独的董事会，一个完全独立的实体，我们已经将该目录移交给了它。

sentences.en: We’re in the process of handing over the domain to it.
sentences.zh: 我们正在将域名移交给它。

sentences.en: So that’s one example.
sentences.zh: 这就是一个例子。

blocks.html_en: We’re also handing the protocol spec itself to the IETF. Last week, the IETF met in Vienna, and AT Proto is now a work stream, an official work stream to take that out of Bluesky and hand it to the IETF. It’s going to become a blessed internet standard run by a completely separate entity. We’re constantly taking all the pieces that we had to bootstrap and handing them off to other entities. We’re super serious about that. The end state is that, yes, we are one app of many, one company of many running in this protocol, and we won’t control the protocol.

sentences.en: We’re also handing the protocol spec itself to the IETF.
sentences.zh: 我们还将协议规范本身交给了 IETF。

sentences.en: Last week, the IETF met in Vienna, and AT Proto is now a work stream, an official work stream to take that out of Bluesky and hand it to the IETF.
sentences.zh: 上周，IETF 在维也纳举行会议，AT Proto 现在成为一个工作流，一个正式的工作流，将其从 Bluesky 中取出并交给 IETF。

sentences.en: It’s going to become a blessed internet standard run by a completely separate entity.
sentences.zh: 它将成为一个由完全独立的实体运行的幸运的互联网标准。

sentences.en: We’re constantly taking all the pieces that we had to bootstrap and handing them off to other entities.
sentences.zh: 我们不断地把必须引导的所有部分交给其他实体。

sentences.en: We’re super serious about that.
sentences.zh: 我们对此非常认真。

sentences.en: The end state is that, yes, we are one app of many, one company of many running in this protocol, and we won’t control the protocol.
sentences.zh: 最终状态是，是的，我们是在该协议中运行的许多应用程序中的一个，是许多公司中的一个，并且我们不会控制该协议。

blocks.html_en: The parallel to Automattic is that WordPress, the core software that Automattic is hosting, is open source and it’s GPL. Anybody can use it, but anybody who uses it and changes it has to give back to open source. In our case, it’s AT Protocol where anybody can build on AT Protocol. The beauty of building on AT Proto as a developer is all the data is owned by users and it’s accessible to any other app. But as an app, then your data also goes into those user repositories. So it makes it better for everybody else on the network. It’s similar to the way open source gets better through collaboration. This network gets better through everybody having their data shared and remixable and interoperable.

sentences.en: The parallel to Automattic is that WordPress, the core software that Automattic is hosting, is open source and it’s GPL.
sentences.zh: 与 Automattic 相似的是，Automattic 托管的核心软件 WordPress 是开源的，并且是 GPL。

sentences.en: Anybody can use it, but anybody who uses it and changes it has to give back to open source.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以使用它，但任何使用它并改变它的人都必须回馈开源。

sentences.en: In our case, it’s AT Protocol where anybody can build on AT Protocol.
sentences.zh: 在我们的例子中，它是 AT 协议，任何人都可以在 AT 协议的基础上进行构建。

sentences.en: The beauty of building on AT Proto as a developer is all the data is owned by users and it’s accessible to any other app.
sentences.zh: 作为开发人员，在 AT Proto 上构建的美妙之处在于所有数据都归用户所有，并且任何其他应用程序都可以访问。

sentences.en: But as an app, then your data also goes into those user repositories.
sentences.zh: 但作为应用程序，您的数据也会进入这些用户存储库。

sentences.en: So it makes it better for everybody else on the network.
sentences.zh: 因此，这对网络上的其他人来说都更好。

sentences.en: It’s similar to the way open source gets better through collaboration.
sentences.zh: 这类似于开源通过协作变得更好的方式。

sentences.en: This network gets better through everybody having their data shared and remixable and interoperable.
sentences.zh: 通过每个人共享数据、可重新混合和互操作数据，这个网络会变得更好。

blocks.html_en: When you get that balance right – or you have a company that helps bootstrap the whole thing, but by definition keeps itself separate and makes sure it can’t control the shared resource – then it can work. We did this successfully with Automattic and WordPress. Automattic became a big company. WordPress became a huge open source ecosystem, and then tons of other companies formed around it. Our test case was always, “What if Automattic goes out of business or gets acquired by somebody evil? Is WordPress going to be okay?” That’s why we put the WordPress trademark into a foundation so the company couldn’t mess with it.

sentences.en: When you get that balance right – or you have a company that helps bootstrap the whole thing, but by definition keeps itself separate and makes sure it can’t control the shared resource – then it can work.
sentences.zh: 当你达到正确的平衡时——或者你有一家公司帮助引导整个事情，但根据定义保持自身独立并确保它无法控制共享资源——那么它就可以发挥作用。

sentences.en: We did this successfully with Automattic and WordPress.
sentences.zh: 我们使用 Automattic 和 WordPress 成功地做到了这一点。

sentences.en: Automattic became a big company.
sentences.zh: Automattic 成为一家大公司。

sentences.en: WordPress became a huge open source ecosystem, and then tons of other companies formed around it.
sentences.zh: WordPress 成为一个巨大的开源生态系统，然后围绕它形成了大量其他公司。

sentences.en: Our test case was always, “What if Automattic goes out of business or gets acquired by somebody evil?
sentences.zh: 我们的测试案例始终是：“如果 Automattic 倒闭或被邪恶之人收购怎么办？

sentences.en: Is WordPress going to be okay?”
sentences.zh: WordPress 会好吗？”

sentences.en: That’s why we put the WordPress trademark into a foundation so the company couldn’t mess with it.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们将 WordPress 商标纳入基础，这样公司就不会乱搞它。

blocks.html_en: It’s complicated to set those things up. This is one of those, not even five years, like 20 years out decisions. If this thing gets big, will it be truly independent? Or could somebody come in and change their mind and mess with it? We think about that constantly at Bluesky and getting that balance right. Handing off pieces so that this – because it’s not going to work if one company tries to control it, we’re right back at square one and we’re just another walled garden, which is completely the opposite of what we’re trying to achieve.

sentences.en: It’s complicated to set those things up.
sentences.zh: 设置这些东西很复杂。

sentences.en: This is one of those, not even five years, like 20 years out decisions.
sentences.zh: 这是其中之一，甚至不到五年，就像 20 年后的决定一样。

sentences.en: If this thing gets big, will it be truly independent?
sentences.zh: 如果这个东西做大了，它就真的能够独立了吗？

sentences.en: Or could somebody come in and change their mind and mess with it?
sentences.zh: 或者有人会改变主意并搞乱它？

sentences.en: We think about that constantly at Bluesky and getting that balance right.
sentences.zh: 我们在 Bluesky 不断思考这一点并取得正确的平衡。

sentences.en: Handing off pieces so that this – because it’s not going to work if one company tries to control it, we’re right back at square one and we’re just another walled garden, which is completely the opposite of what we’re trying to achieve.
sentences.zh: 交出部分，这样——因为如果一家公司试图控制它，这是行不通的，我们又回到了原点，我们只是另一个有围墙的花园，这与我们想要实现的目标完全相反。

blocks.html_en: There’s a lot of drama with WordPress and the open-source community and other companies monetizing open-source in different ways. There’s drama with the foundation. I’ll set that all aside. People can go listen to Matt’s episodes. We did it in detail, and certainly will have him back. I like talking to Matt a lot. But that’s all coming for you too, because at some point all of this has to make money.

sentences.en: There’s a lot of drama with WordPress and the open-source community and other companies monetizing open-source in different ways.
sentences.zh: WordPress 和开源社区以及其他公司以不同的方式通过开源货币化有很多戏剧性的事情。

sentences.en: There’s drama with the foundation.
sentences.zh: 基金会有戏剧性。

sentences.en: I’ll set that all aside.
sentences.zh: 我会把这一切放在一边。

sentences.en: People can go listen to Matt’s episodes.
sentences.zh: 人们可以去听马特的剧集。

sentences.en: We did it in detail, and certainly will have him back.
sentences.zh: 我们做得很详细，肯定会让他回来。

sentences.en: I like talking to Matt a lot.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢和马特说话。

sentences.en: But that’s all coming for you too, because at some point all of this has to make money.
sentences.zh: 但这一切也会为你而来，因为在某些时候，所有这些都必须赚钱。

blocks.html_en: A real theme on Decoder is we’ve set up complicated structures so that capitalism can’t ruin everything. We just had Proton on the show. Complicated Swiss foundation structure so that capitalism can’t ruin everything and all the promises they make to their customers. You don’t have that problem yet. As far as I can tell, there’s no revenue flowing into this and probably thus no push to make that revenue number go up in bad ways. At some point there is going to have to be some revenue. You’re an investor. I’m assuming you want to get paid out into your own fund. How is Bluesky going to make money on the app level, and how is the protocol going to make any money?

sentences.en: A real theme on Decoder is we’ve set up complicated structures so that capitalism can’t ruin everything.
sentences.zh: Decoder 的一个真正主题是我们建立了复杂的结构，这样资本主义就不会毁掉一切。

sentences.en: We just had Proton on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚在节目中展示了 Proton。

sentences.en: Complicated Swiss foundation structure so that capitalism can’t ruin everything and all the promises they make to their customers.
sentences.zh: 复杂的瑞士基础结构使资本主义无法破坏他们对客户做出的一切和所有承诺。

sentences.en: You don’t have that problem yet.
sentences.zh: 你还没有这个问题。

sentences.en: As far as I can tell, there’s no revenue flowing into this and probably thus no push to make that revenue number go up in bad ways.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，没有任何收入流入，因此可能没有推动该收入数字以不良方式增长。

sentences.en: At some point there is going to have to be some revenue.
sentences.zh: 到了某个时候，就必须有一些收入。

sentences.en: You’re an investor.
sentences.zh: 你是一个投资者。

sentences.en: I’m assuming you want to get paid out into your own fund.
sentences.zh: 我假设您想将资金存入您自己的基金。

sentences.en: How is Bluesky going to make money on the app level, and how is the protocol going to make any money?
sentences.zh: Bluesky 将如何在应用程序层面赚钱？该协议将如何赚钱？

blocks.html_en: The way we’re going to make money as a company, we’re only interested if that economic model works for the entire ATmosphere. We make money when everybody else makes money. That rules out a bunch of things that will be purely app-based. I’m not ready to announce the specifics, but we will start monetizing this year. The way I look at it is there’s already money being made on this network. We’re sending lots of traffic to people who then convert that traffic into subscriptions.. I think our job is to just help more of that happen. Right now it’s just organic, and we can build things into our app and into the protocol that make it easier for people to start making a livelihood on this protocol and start doing ecommerce with each other. That’s the direction we’re headed in. We’re going to do it in a way where the whole idea is for the pie to get huge and for us to be a small slice of a big pie and for everybody to make money. If we can help you as a publisher make more money, then we can do business together.

sentences.en: The way we’re going to make money as a company, we’re only interested if that economic model works for the entire ATmosphere.
sentences.zh: 作为一家公司，我们赚钱的方式是，我们只对这种经济模式是否适用于整个大气层感兴趣。

sentences.en: We make money when everybody else makes money.
sentences.zh: 当其他人赚钱时我们也赚钱。

sentences.en: That rules out a bunch of things that will be purely app-based.
sentences.zh: 这就排除了很多纯粹基于应用程序的事情。

sentences.en: I’m not ready to announce the specifics, but we will start monetizing this year.
sentences.zh: 我还没有准备好宣布具体细节，但我们将在今年开始货币化。

sentences.en: The way I look at it is there’s already money being made on this network.
sentences.zh: 我的看法是，这个网络已经赚钱了。

sentences.en: We’re sending lots of traffic to people who then convert that traffic into subscriptions..
sentences.zh: 我们向人们发送大量流量，然后将这些流量转化为订阅。

sentences.en: I think our job is to just help more of that happen.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们的工作就是帮助更多的事情发生。

sentences.en: Right now it’s just organic, and we can build things into our app and into the protocol that make it easier for people to start making a livelihood on this protocol and start doing ecommerce with each other.
sentences.zh: 现在它只是有机的，我们可以将一些东西构建到我们的应用程序和协议中，使人们更容易开始在这个协议上谋生并开始相互进行电子商务。

sentences.en: That’s the direction we’re headed in.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们前进的方向。

sentences.en: We’re going to do it in a way where the whole idea is for the pie to get huge and for us to be a small slice of a big pie and for everybody to make money.
sentences.zh: 我们将以这样一种方式来做这件事：整个想法是让蛋糕变得更大，让我们成为大蛋糕中的一小部分，让每个人都能赚钱。

sentences.en: If we can help you as a publisher make more money, then we can do business together.
sentences.zh: 如果我们可以帮助您作为出版商赚更多的钱，那么我们就可以一起做生意。

blocks.html_en: I know you said you weren’t going to do specifics, but I have to poke at this a little bit. Your options, if you want a small piece of a big pie, are “We’re going to let you run ads for your subscription newsletter and then that’ll convert.” That’s Facebook’s model, right? “We’re going to let you run ads at whatever CPM, and your return on ad spend will be high enough so that enough subscribers signed up based on how many ads you were on.” And the other one is, “We’re just going to take a percentage of every signup fee.” Which direction do you think you’re headed in?

sentences.en: I know you said you weren’t going to do specifics, but I have to poke at this a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我知道你说过你不会透露具体细节，但我必须稍微探讨一下。

sentences.en: Your options, if you want a small piece of a big pie, are “We’re going to let you run ads for your subscription newsletter and then that’ll convert.”
sentences.zh: 如果你想在大蛋糕中分得一小部分，你的选择是“我们将让你为你的订阅新闻通讯投放广告，然后这就会转化。”

sentences.en: That’s Facebook’s model, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是 Facebook 的模式，对吗？

sentences.en: “We’re going to let you run ads at whatever CPM, and your return on ad spend will be high enough so that enough subscribers signed up based on how many ads you were on.”
sentences.zh: “我们将让你以任何每千次展示费用（CPM）投放广告，并且你的广告支出回报率将足够高，以便根据你投放的广告数量有足够的订阅者注册。”

sentences.en: And the other one is, “We’re just going to take a percentage of every signup fee.”
sentences.zh: 另一个是，“我们只收取每笔注册费的一定比例。”

sentences.en: Which direction do you think you’re headed in?
sentences.zh: 您认为您正在朝哪个方向前进？

blocks.html_en: It would definitely be the latter, but we would only take a percentage of anything that we actually enable. If we send extra traffic to you, then it would be a percentage of that.

sentences.en: It would definitely be the latter, but we would only take a percentage of anything that we actually enable.
sentences.zh: 肯定是后者，但我们只会抽取我们实际启用的任何内容的一部分。

sentences.en: If we send extra traffic to you, then it would be a percentage of that.
sentences.zh: 如果我们向您发送额外的流量，那么这将是其中的一个百分比。

blocks.html_en: So basically affiliate-style monetization. If I’m selling a newsletter for $10 a month and you send me a new subscriber, you’re going to get some of that back.

sentences.en: So basically affiliate-style monetization.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上是联盟式的货币化。

sentences.en: If I’m selling a newsletter for $10 a month and you send me a new subscriber, you’re going to get some of that back.
sentences.zh: 如果我以每月 10 美元的价格出售时事通讯，而您向我发送了一位新订阅者，您将获得其中的一部分。

blocks.html_en: Affiliate style and in a way that works for the entire network. Anybody on the network that sends you traffic can participate. We want everybody to have a part in it.

sentences.en: Affiliate style and in a way that works for the entire network.
sentences.zh: 联盟风格以及适用于整个网络的方式。

sentences.en: Anybody on the network that sends you traffic can participate.
sentences.zh: 网络上向您发送流量的任何人都可以参与。

sentences.en: We want everybody to have a part in it.
sentences.zh: 我们希望每个人都参与其中。

blocks.html_en: Can you decentralize the billing and financial layer of that?

sentences.en: Can you decentralize the billing and financial layer of that?
sentences.zh: 你能分散计费和财务层吗？

blocks.html_en: We can make it work in a decentralized network. Billing does require some centralized trust, and that’s certainly something we’re looking at.

sentences.en: We can make it work in a decentralized network.
sentences.zh: 我们可以让它在去中心化网络中运行。

sentences.en: Billing does require some centralized trust, and that’s certainly something we’re looking at.
sentences.zh: 计费确实需要一些集中的信任，这当然是我们正在考虑的事情。

blocks.html_en: I asked you that question because I was terrified of a crypto scheme basically, but it does not sound like you’re going to do crypto schemes.

sentences.en: I asked you that question because I was terrified of a crypto scheme basically, but it does not sound like you’re going to do crypto schemes.
sentences.zh: 我问你这个问题是因为我基本上害怕加密方案，但听起来你并不打算做加密方案。

blocks.html_en: No, no. Similar intentions, but definitely not a crypto approach.

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不不。

sentences.en: Similar intentions, but definitely not a crypto approach.
sentences.zh: 类似的意图，但绝对不是加密方法。

blocks.html_en: One of the things that you’ve been describing is, “We have to build all these structures to withstand the bad incentives. If somebody shows up and buys Bluesky, and they’ve got bad intentions or they just want to use it to do crypto schemes, we have to build the structure that will withstand it.” Adding monetization in whatever form – and I agree the network should be monetized in some way – creates a bunch of these incentives at first launch. It will be your first contact with those incentives. You have some experience with this, certainly even thinking about it. How do you expect that to go both with your team and with the user base of Bluesky itself?

sentences.en: One of the things that you’ve been describing is, “We have to build all these structures to withstand the bad incentives.
sentences.zh: 你一直在描述的一件事是，“我们必须建立所有这些结构来承受不良激励。

sentences.en: If somebody shows up and buys Bluesky, and they’ve got bad intentions or they just want to use it to do crypto schemes, we have to build the structure that will withstand it.”
sentences.zh: 如果有人出现并购买 Bluesky，并且他们有恶意，或者他们只是想用它来进行加密方案，我们就必须构建能够承受它的结构。”

sentences.en: Adding monetization in whatever form – and I agree the network should be monetized in some way – creates a bunch of these incentives at first launch.
sentences.zh: 以任何形式添加货币化——我同意网络应该以某种方式货币化——在首次发布时会产生一系列激励措施。

sentences.en: It will be your first contact with those incentives.
sentences.zh: 这将是您第一次接触这些激励措施。

sentences.en: You have some experience with this, certainly even thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 你对此有一些经验，当然甚至想过它。

sentences.en: How do you expect that to go both with your team and with the user base of Bluesky itself?
sentences.zh: 您预计您的团队和 Bluesky 本身的用户群会如何发展？

blocks.html_en: The team is eager to figure this out because we realize that there has to be an economic model for this network. Otherwise, we’re in the early bootstrap phase still and lots of people are getting excited to build on this. But it’s the number-one question for my team, from all the people building. “What’s that model going to be?” Everybody’s eager to figure this out and to do it in a way that we don’t fall into the traps of trying to create the incentives that we’ve seen in other networks, which just cause all kinds of unintended consequences.

sentences.en: The team is eager to figure this out because we realize that there has to be an economic model for this network.
sentences.zh: 该团队渴望解决这个问题，因为我们意识到这个网络必须有一个经济模型。

sentences.en: Otherwise, we’re in the early bootstrap phase still and lots of people are getting excited to build on this.
sentences.zh: 否则，我们仍处于早期引导阶段，很多人都对在此基础上继续发展感到兴奋。

sentences.en: But it’s the number-one question for my team, from all the people building.
sentences.zh: 但这是我的团队以及所有建设人员面临的首要问题。

sentences.en: “What’s that model going to be?”
sentences.zh: “那个模型会是什么？”

sentences.en: Everybody’s eager to figure this out and to do it in a way that we don’t fall into the traps of trying to create the incentives that we’ve seen in other networks, which just cause all kinds of unintended consequences.
sentences.zh: 每个人都渴望弄清楚这一点，并以一种我们不会陷入在其他网络中看到的试图创造激励措施的陷阱的方式来做到这一点，这只会导致各种意想不到的后果。

blocks.html_en: Looping back on the WordPress example, it can work really nicely. WordPress is a slightly different model because it’s a hosting model. But there are thousands and thousands of WordPress hosts out there that are doing just fine and it just works. You can host your site anywhere, you can move it anywhere. They compete to be the best host for your content, but it’s a very good model. As far as I can tell, it hasn’t created anybody to take all the market share or create these weird incentives where the product gets worse.

sentences.en: Looping back on the WordPress example, it can work really nicely.
sentences.zh: 回到 WordPress 的例子，它可以很好地工作。

sentences.en: WordPress is a slightly different model because it’s a hosting model.
sentences.zh: WordPress 是一个略有不同的模型，因为它是一个托管模型。

sentences.en: But there are thousands and thousands of WordPress hosts out there that are doing just fine and it just works.
sentences.zh: 但有成千上万的 WordPress 主机运行得很好并且可以正常工作。

sentences.en: You can host your site anywhere, you can move it anywhere.
sentences.zh: 您可以在任何地方托管您的网站，也可以将其移动到任何地方。

sentences.en: They compete to be the best host for your content, but it’s a very good model.
sentences.zh: 他们竞相成为您内容的最佳托管者，但这是一个非常好的模式。

sentences.en: As far as I can tell, it hasn’t created anybody to take all the market share or create these weird incentives where the product gets worse.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，它并没有创造任何人来占据所有市场份额或在产品变得更糟的情况下创造这些奇怪的激励措施。

blocks.html_en: There’s a very nice dividing line there between “I’m your host” and “you go and do whatever you want.” You can build an ad network if you want. You can build a store, you can build something else. Our business model doesn’t dictate what your business model should be, which is kind of what happens in these other networks when it’s only ads. “Oh yeah, come here, build your following on here and then we’re going to put ads on it. If you want to do anything else, no, no, no, it’s going to be ads.”

sentences.en: There’s a very nice dividing line there between “I’m your host” and “you go and do whatever you want.”
sentences.zh: “我是你的主人”和“你去做你想做的事”之间有一条非常好的分界线。

sentences.en: You can build an ad network if you want.
sentences.zh: 如果需要，您可以建立广告网络。

sentences.en: You can build a store, you can build something else.
sentences.zh: 你可以建造一家商店，也可以建造其他东西。

sentences.en: Our business model doesn’t dictate what your business model should be, which is kind of what happens in these other networks when it’s only ads.
sentences.zh: 我们的商业模式并不决定您的商业模式应该是什么，这就像其他网络中仅包含广告时所发生的情况一样。

sentences.en: “Oh yeah, come here, build your following on here and then we’re going to put ads on it.
sentences.zh: “哦，是的，来这里，在这里建立你的追随者，然后我们将在上面放广告。

sentences.en: If you want to do anything else, no, no, no, it’s going to be ads.”
sentences.zh: 如果你想做其他任何事情，不不不，那就是广告。”

blocks.html_en: Those are the kinds of things we think about. Talking about irreversible decisions, that’s going to be a huge one when we start to zero in on the right model to make sure that we can picture this scaling to billions of users and all kinds of businesses emerging on this network, not just one type that we happen to think about.

sentences.en: Those are the kinds of things we think about.
sentences.zh: 这些就是我们所思考的事情。

sentences.en: Talking about irreversible decisions, that’s going to be a huge one when we start to zero in on the right model to make sure that we can picture this scaling to billions of users and all kinds of businesses emerging on this network, not just one type that we happen to think about.
sentences.zh: 谈到不可逆转的决定，当我们开始将正确的模型归零时，这将是一个巨大的决定，以确保我们能够将这种规模扩展到数十亿用户以及该网络上出现的各种业务，而不仅仅是我们碰巧想到的一种类型。

blocks.html_en: You’ve mentioned Blacksky a handful of times in this conversation. I’ve been lucky enough to be at a dinner with Rudy [Fraser] who runs Blacksky. He’s prolific in talking about what it’s like to actually build on the ATmosphere and what a lot of the challenges have been. Because it hasn’t yet really, truly been decentralized.

sentences.en: You’ve mentioned Blacksky a handful of times in this conversation.
sentences.zh: 你在这次谈话中多次提到了布莱克斯基。

sentences.en: I’ve been lucky enough to be at a dinner with Rudy [Fraser] who runs Blacksky.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运能够与 Blacksky 的经营者 Rudy [Fraser] 共进晚餐。

sentences.en: He’s prolific in talking about what it’s like to actually build on the ATmosphere and what a lot of the challenges have been.
sentences.zh: 他经常谈论在 ATmosphere 上实际构建的感觉以及所面临的许多挑战。

sentences.en: Because it hasn’t yet really, truly been decentralized.
sentences.zh: 因为它还没有真正实现去中心化。

blocks.html_en: Now it’s my turn to say, I won’t go into the weeds of the protocol, but there are parts of the Bluesky stack and parts of the ATmosphere that have been pretty heavily centralized up until fairly recently. Is it easy to stand up a competitor, in the way that you’re describing people can stand up competitors to WordPress and operate in their own universe using the same tools and same access to end customers? Or is there still work to be done there? Because it hasn’t been easy up until now, at least using the example of Blacksky.

sentences.en: Now it’s my turn to say, I won’t go into the weeds of the protocol, but there are parts of the Bluesky stack and parts of the ATmosphere that have been pretty heavily centralized up until fairly recently.
sentences.zh: 现在轮到我说，我不会深入讨论该协议的细节，但 Bluesky 堆栈的某些部分和 ATmosphere 的某些部分直到最近才相当集中。

sentences.en: Is it easy to stand up a competitor, in the way that you’re describing people can stand up competitors to WordPress and operate in their own universe using the same tools and same access to end customers?
sentences.zh: 对抗竞争对手是否容易，就像您所描述的那样，人们可以对抗 WordPress 的竞争对手，并使用相同的工具和对最终客户的相同访问权限在自己的领域中运营？

sentences.en: Or is there still work to be done there?
sentences.zh: 或者那里还有工作要做吗？

sentences.en: Because it hasn’t been easy up until now, at least using the example of Blacksky.
sentences.zh: 因为到目前为止这并不容易，至少以 Blacksky 为例。

blocks.html_en: Rudy deserves a lot of credit for taking those early risks when it was much harder to build and being the first to prove that it can be done, but it’s getting easier and easier. We are seeing more and more Bluesky- and Blacksky-style networks pop up pretty often. We’re actually seeing a whole bunch of energy in Europe. We’ve got Eurosky. W Social just launched. There’s another one I think that’s about to launch.

sentences.en: Rudy deserves a lot of credit for taking those early risks when it was much harder to build and being the first to prove that it can be done, but it’s getting easier and easier.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪在建造起来更加困难时承担了这些早期风险，并成为第一个证明它可以完成的人，因此值得称赞，但它变得越来越容易。

sentences.en: We are seeing more and more Bluesky- and Blacksky-style networks pop up pretty often.
sentences.zh: 我们经常看到越来越多的蓝天和黑天风格的网络出现。

sentences.en: We’re actually seeing a whole bunch of energy in Europe.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上在欧洲看到了巨大的能量。

sentences.en: We’ve got Eurosky.
sentences.zh: 我们有欧洲天空电视台。

sentences.en: W Social just launched.
sentences.zh: W Social 刚刚推出。

sentences.en: There’s another one I think that’s about to launch.
sentences.zh: 我认为还有另一项即将推出。

blocks.html_en: It’s getting easier, and we’re investing a lot to make it as easy as possible. In addition to being an open protocol, all of Bluesky’s open source. You can take the Bluesky app and just fork it and go do your own Bluesky. That’s great, but we’re really also interested in people building other things that are microblogging on the network and making that super easy.

sentences.en: It’s getting easier, and we’re investing a lot to make it as easy as possible.
sentences.zh: 它变得越来越容易，我们正在投入大量资金以使其尽可能简单。

sentences.en: In addition to being an open protocol, all of Bluesky’s open source.
sentences.zh: 除了作为一个开放协议之外，Bluesky 的所有内容都是开源的。

sentences.en: You can take the Bluesky app and just fork it and go do your own Bluesky.
sentences.zh: 您可以使用 Bluesky 应用程序并分叉它，然后去做您自己的 Bluesky。

sentences.en: That’s great, but we’re really also interested in people building other things that are microblogging on the network and making that super easy.
sentences.zh: 这太好了，但我们也确实对人们在网络上构建其他东西（例如微博）并使其变得超级简单感兴趣。

blocks.html_en: We’re seeing Tangled as an example that a lot of people like to use recently because it’s a great project. They raised VC funding. It’s a social coding platform, like a social GitHub that’s growing really nicely using AT Proto for the social layer of the social coding aspect. Has nothing to do with microblogging, but it’s another thing that we can collaborate and integrate. People use both Tangled and Bluesky. It all just works together. But those are examples where it’s getting really easy to just build a new app on AT Proto and have it have social functionality. It doesn’t have to be an entire Bluesky-style network that you have to run.

sentences.en: We’re seeing Tangled as an example that a lot of people like to use recently because it’s a great project.
sentences.zh: 我们看到《魔发奇缘》是最近很多人喜欢使用的一个例子，因为它是一个很棒的项目。

sentences.en: They raised VC funding.
sentences.zh: 他们筹集了风险投资资金。

sentences.en: It’s a social coding platform, like a social GitHub that’s growing really nicely using AT Proto for the social layer of the social coding aspect.
sentences.zh: 它是一个社交编码平台，就像社交 GitHub 一样，使用 AT Proto 作为社交编码方面的社交层，发展得非常好。

sentences.en: Has nothing to do with microblogging, but it’s another thing that we can collaborate and integrate.
sentences.zh: 与微博无关，但这是我们可以协作和整合的另一件事。

sentences.en: People use both Tangled and Bluesky.
sentences.zh: 人们同时使用《魔发奇缘》和《蓝天》。

sentences.en: It all just works together.
sentences.zh: 这一切都在一起发挥作用。

sentences.en: But those are examples where it’s getting really easy to just build a new app on AT Proto and have it have social functionality.
sentences.zh: 但这些例子表明，在 AT Proto 上构建新应用程序并使其具有社交功能变得非常容易。

sentences.en: It doesn’t have to be an entire Bluesky-style network that you have to run.
sentences.zh: 它不必是您必须运行的整个 Bluesky 式网络。

blocks.html_en: We put effort into making it easier. When Blacksky started two or three years ago, it was a big lift. You had to be very technical to do it. Now it’s gotten easier and easier.

sentences.en: We put effort into making it easier.
sentences.zh: 我们努力让它变得更容易。

sentences.en: When Blacksky started two or three years ago, it was a big lift.
sentences.zh: Blacksky 在两三年前成立时，取得了巨大的进步。

sentences.en: You had to be very technical to do it.
sentences.zh: 你必须非常有技术才能做到这一点。

sentences.en: Now it’s gotten easier and easier.
sentences.zh: 现在变得越来越容易了。

blocks.html_en: Finally, we haven’t talked about AI yet. AI makes it even easier. A lot of the growth we’re seeing now is that you can point to one of the AI coding tools on AT Proto and say, “Hey, build me a social app, build me a community.” And that makes it that much easier. Those are some of the tools and integrations that we’re working on on Jay’s new team, but that really changes the game pretty substantially for just how easy all this stuff is getting.

sentences.en: Finally, we haven’t talked about AI yet.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们还没有讨论人工智能。

sentences.en: AI makes it even easier.
sentences.zh: 人工智能让它变得更加容易。

sentences.en: A lot of the growth we’re seeing now is that you can point to one of the AI coding tools on AT Proto and say, “Hey, build me a social app, build me a community.”
sentences.zh: 我们现在看到的很多增长是，你可以指着 AT Proto 上的一个人工智能编码工具说：“嘿，为我构建一个社交应用程序，为我构建一个社区。”

sentences.en: And that makes it that much easier.
sentences.zh: 这使得事情变得更加容易。

sentences.en: Those are some of the tools and integrations that we’re working on on Jay’s new team, but that really changes the game pretty substantially for just how easy all this stuff is getting.
sentences.zh: 这些是我们正在 Jay 的新团队中开发的一些工具和集成，但这确实极大地改变了游戏，因为所有这些东西变得多么容易。

blocks.html_en: I do have to ask you the AI question. You’re a software CEO again. How do software companies work in the age of AI? Have you rethought your teams? Do you have the traditional product-manager-designer-engineer trio? Or is everybody doing everything? It’s a small team and you’re the new CEO. So you have lots of opportunity to rethink everything.

sentences.en: I do have to ask you the AI question.
sentences.zh: 我确实要问你人工智能问题。

sentences.en: You’re a software CEO again.
sentences.zh: 你再次成为软件首席执行官。

sentences.en: How do software companies work in the age of AI?
sentences.zh: 人工智能时代的软件公司如何运作？

sentences.en: Have you rethought your teams?
sentences.zh: 你重新考虑过你的团队吗？

sentences.en: Do you have the traditional product-manager-designer-engineer trio?
sentences.zh: 你们有传统的产品经理、设计师、工程师三人组吗？

sentences.en: Or is everybody doing everything?
sentences.zh: 还是每个人都在做一切？

sentences.en: It’s a small team and you’re the new CEO.
sentences.zh: 这是一个小团队，而你是新任首席执行官。

sentences.en: So you have lots of opportunity to rethink everything.
sentences.zh: 所以你有很多机会重新思考一切。

blocks.html_en: It is very empowering once you get it right. We have to use our exploration team as an example. That’s a three- to four-person team that’s launching at very high velocity, launching brand new products. It’s really fun when you have an existing company with existing resources and very senior talented people can then go after a new greenfield opportunity with these new tools. That’s when you see a ton of velocity.

sentences.en: It is very empowering once you get it right.
sentences.zh: 一旦你做对了，它就会非常有力量。

sentences.en: We have to use our exploration team as an example.
sentences.zh: 我们必须以我们的勘探队为例。

sentences.en: That’s a three- to four-person team that’s launching at very high velocity, launching brand new products.
sentences.zh: 这是一个三到四人的团队，以非常高的速度推出全新产品。

sentences.en: It’s really fun when you have an existing company with existing resources and very senior talented people can then go after a new greenfield opportunity with these new tools.
sentences.zh: 当您拥有一家拥有现有资源和非常资深的人才的现有公司，然后可以使用这些新工具寻找新的机会时，这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: That’s when you see a ton of velocity.
sentences.zh: 那就是你看到大量速度的时候。

blocks.html_en: If you have an existing product with all the complexity of how it’s been built, AI helps, but you’re still dealing with that same complexity for a while. I see it accelerate everything in terms of the development pace. You still need great product managers, you need great designers. You need [to know] how to build. The building part is faster than what to build. The ideas are just as hard as ever, in a way harder because there’s so much noise out there and so many things popping up every day. Setting yourself apart, building something really great that lasts. Just because it’s faster with AI doesn’t make it any easier.

sentences.en: If you have an existing product with all the complexity of how it’s been built, AI helps, but you’re still dealing with that same complexity for a while.
sentences.zh: 如果您现有的产品具有其构建方式的所有复杂性，人工智能会有所帮助，但您仍然需要处理同样的复杂性一段时间。

sentences.en: I see it accelerate everything in terms of the development pace.
sentences.zh: 我认为它加快了一切的发展速度。

sentences.en: You still need great product managers, you need great designers.
sentences.zh: 你仍然需要优秀的产品经理，你需要优秀的设计师。

sentences.en: You need [to know] how to build.
sentences.zh: 您需要[知道]如何构建。

sentences.en: The building part is faster than what to build.
sentences.zh: 构建部分比构建内容更快。

sentences.en: The ideas are just as hard as ever, in a way harder because there’s so much noise out there and so many things popping up every day.
sentences.zh: 这些想法和以前一样困难，在某种程度上更困难，因为外面有太多的噪音，每天都有那么多的事情出现。

sentences.en: Setting yourself apart, building something really great that lasts.
sentences.zh: 让自己与众不同，打造真正持久的伟大事物。

sentences.en: Just because it’s faster with AI doesn’t make it any easier.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为人工智能速度更快并不意味着事情变得更容易。

blocks.html_en: We’ve talked a lot about standards and making AT Protocol and the ATmosphere a more standardized project at the IETF and whatever Swiss foundation is going to do name lookups. It feels like we’re going to recapitulate ICANN. But that’s a totally different episode of Decoder, and we’ll come to that drama when everything is successful.

sentences.en: We’ve talked a lot about standards and making AT Protocol and the ATmosphere a more standardized project at the IETF and whatever Swiss foundation is going to do name lookups.
sentences.zh: 我们已经讨论了很多关于标准以及如何使 AT 协议和 ATmosphere 成为 IETF 以及瑞士基金会将进行的名称查找的更加标准化的项目。

sentences.en: It feels like we’re going to recapitulate ICANN.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像我们要重述 ICANN 一样。

sentences.en: But that’s a totally different episode of Decoder, and we’ll come to that drama when everything is successful.
sentences.zh: 但这是《解码器》中完全不同的一集，当一切顺利时我们就会看到那出戏。

blocks.html_en: There is another standard that has already gone through all this. There’s ActivityPub. Mastodon runs an ActivityPub. Famously, Threads runs an ActivityPub, to whatever extent Threads runs on ActivityPub. There’s an argument that Meta did all of that just to satisfy European regulators, and that’s all it’s there for.

sentences.en: There is another standard that has already gone through all this.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个标准已经经历了这一切。

sentences.en: There’s ActivityPub.
sentences.zh: 有 ActivityPub。

sentences.en: Mastodon runs an ActivityPub.
sentences.zh: Mastodon 经营一家 ActivityPub。

sentences.en: Famously, Threads runs an ActivityPub, to whatever extent Threads runs on ActivityPub.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，Threads 运行一个 ActivityPub，无论 Threads 在 ActivityPub 上运行到什么程度。

sentences.en: There’s an argument that Meta did all of that just to satisfy European regulators, and that’s all it’s there for.
sentences.zh: 有人认为，Meta 所做的一切只是为了满足欧洲监管机构的要求，而这就是它的全部目的。

blocks.html_en: Have you talked to the Threads team about integrating with ActivityPub or moving them to the ATmosphere? Once you become an official standard, I imagine that must be easier for them to continue throwing bones to European regulators. That would be the big unlock, right? That is the hundreds of millions of users on a nominally open network. Have they shown any interest?

sentences.en: Have you talked to the Threads team about integrating with ActivityPub or moving them to the ATmosphere?
sentences.zh: 您是否与 Threads 团队讨论过与 ActivityPub 集成或将其移至 ATmosphere？

sentences.en: Once you become an official standard, I imagine that must be easier for them to continue throwing bones to European regulators.
sentences.zh: 一旦成为官方标准，我想他们一定会更容易继续向欧洲监管机构扔骨头。

sentences.en: That would be the big unlock, right?
sentences.zh: 这将是一个大解锁，对吧？

sentences.en: That is the hundreds of millions of users on a nominally open network.
sentences.zh: 这是名义上开放网络上的数亿用户。

sentences.en: Have they shown any interest?
sentences.zh: 他们表现出任何兴趣吗？

blocks.html_en: We have not talked to Threads. We’re definitely talking to Mastodon and ActivityPub. They definitely feel we’re very aligned. Our missions are very aligned. We’re all on Team Open together. These are two different standards that do slightly different things. And some use cases for ActivityPub are great and some are great for AT Proto.

sentences.en: We have not talked to Threads.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有与 Threads 交谈过。

sentences.en: We’re definitely talking to Mastodon and ActivityPub.
sentences.zh: 我们肯定是在与 Mastodon 和 ActivityPub 交谈。

sentences.en: They definitely feel we’re very aligned.
sentences.zh: 他们肯定觉得我们非常一致。

sentences.en: Our missions are very aligned.
sentences.zh: 我们的使命非常一致。

sentences.en: We’re all on Team Open together.
sentences.zh: 我们都是 Team Open 的一员。

sentences.en: These are two different standards that do slightly different things.
sentences.zh: 这是两个不同的标准，它们的作用略有不同。

sentences.en: And some use cases for ActivityPub are great and some are great for AT Proto.
sentences.zh: ActivityPub 的某些用例非常好，有些用例对于 AT Proto 也非常好。

blocks.html_en: What are use cases that are good in ActivityPub and what are use cases that are better in AT Protocol?

sentences.en: What are use cases that are good in ActivityPub and what are use cases that are better in AT Protocol?
sentences.zh: ActivityPub 中哪些用例较好，AT 协议中哪些用例更好？

blocks.html_en: ActivityPub is based around this notion of a server. At the heart of it, you set up your own server, you control it, you run it, that’s your community, and then all the servers can federate if you want. You don’t have to, you can just run it by yourself, or you can plug into the federation, into the Fediverse. That’s how their system works. It works really well. They have a lot of successful governments who want to set up their own server infrastructure and run their own community infrastructure.

sentences.en: ActivityPub is based around this notion of a server.
sentences.zh: ActivityPub 是基于服务器这一概念的。

sentences.en: At the heart of it, you set up your own server, you control it, you run it, that’s your community, and then all the servers can federate if you want.
sentences.zh: 其核心是，您设置自己的服务器，控制它，运行它，这就是您的社区，然后如果您愿意，所有服务器都可以联合起来。

sentences.en: You don’t have to, you can just run it by yourself, or you can plug into the federation, into the Fediverse.
sentences.zh: 你不必这样做，你可以自己运行它，或者你可以插入联邦，插入Fediverse。

sentences.en: That’s how their system works.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的系统的工作原理。

sentences.en: It works really well.
sentences.zh: 效果非常好。

sentences.en: They have a lot of successful governments who want to set up their own server infrastructure and run their own community infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 他们有很多成功的政府想要建立自己的服务器基础设施并运行自己的社区基础设施。

blocks.html_en: AT Proto has a different goal. We don’t have a server at the heart of it. We have the PDS, the personal data server that is your data. The heart of AT Proto is personal identity and portability and ownership of that so that whatever you create and the social graph that you create is owned by you and lifts wherever you want to host it. It’s really a federation of millions and millions of these tiny little personal servers that can all talk to each other. That works if your social product is focused on people, not on an entire server with a community on it.

sentences.en: AT Proto has a different goal.
sentences.zh: AT Proto 有不同的目标。

sentences.en: We don’t have a server at the heart of it.
sentences.zh: 我们没有核心服务器。

sentences.en: We have the PDS, the personal data server that is your data.
sentences.zh: 我们有 PDS，即您的数据的个人数据服务器。

sentences.en: The heart of AT Proto is personal identity and portability and ownership of that so that whatever you create and the social graph that you create is owned by you and lifts wherever you want to host it.
sentences.zh: AT Proto 的核心是个人身份、可移植性和所有权，因此您创建的任何内容以及您创建的社交图谱都归您所有，并且可以随您的意愿托管。

sentences.en: It’s really a federation of millions and millions of these tiny little personal servers that can all talk to each other.
sentences.zh: 它实际上是由数以百万计的小型个人服务器组成的联盟，这些服务器都可以相互通信。

sentences.en: That works if your social product is focused on people, not on an entire server with a community on it.
sentences.zh: 如果您的社交产品专注于人，而不是包含社区的整个服务器，那么这种方法就有效。

blocks.html_en: So a slightly different shape. They interoperate too. There’s something called Bridgy Fed that connects these two worlds together. So if you’ve built products on this yourself, if you want to post or publish across all of it, you can and the end user doesn’t even have to know. That’s the beauty of an open protocol: you shouldn’t have to. Consumers of this should never even hear about these new protocols. Because it’s one of these things where you have to get the protocol right and it has to be open, but then people should just forget about it. It should just disappear.

sentences.en: So a slightly different shape.
sentences.zh: 所以形状略有不同。

sentences.en: They interoperate too.
sentences.zh: 它们也可以互操作。

sentences.en: There’s something called Bridgy Fed that connects these two worlds together.
sentences.zh: 有一种叫做 Bridgy Fed 的东西将这两个世界连接在一起。

sentences.en: So if you’ve built products on this yourself, if you want to post or publish across all of it, you can and the end user doesn’t even have to know.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果您自己在此基础上构建了产品，如果您想发布或发布所有这些内容，您就可以，而且最终用户甚至不必知道。

sentences.en: That’s the beauty of an open protocol: you shouldn’t have to.
sentences.zh: 这就是开放协议的美妙之处：你不应该这样做。

sentences.en: Consumers of this should never even hear about these new protocols.
sentences.zh: 消费者永远不应该听说这些新协议。

sentences.en: Because it’s one of these things where you have to get the protocol right and it has to be open, but then people should just forget about it.
sentences.zh: 因为这是你必须制定正确的协议并且必须开放的事情之一，但人们应该忘记它。

sentences.en: It should just disappear.
sentences.zh: 它应该会消失。

blocks.html_en: The examples we use a lot are email and websites. If I’m on Outlook and you’re on Gmail, we can just email each other. You never think about the fact that those are two completely separate systems. It just works. But on social media, it just doesn’t work that way. If you’re on Instagram and I’m on TikTok, we can’t talk to each other. You have to do everything five different times and on five different apps, and it’s crazy making. If we get this right at the protocol level, that just goes away. All this stuff just works just like email does or just like websites do.

sentences.en: The examples we use a lot are email and websites.
sentences.zh: 我们经常使用的例子是电子邮件和网站。

sentences.en: If I’m on Outlook and you’re on Gmail, we can just email each other.
sentences.zh: 如果我使用 Outlook 而你使用 Gmail，我们就可以互相发送电子邮件。

sentences.en: You never think about the fact that those are two completely separate systems.
sentences.zh: 你永远不会想到这是两个完全独立的系统这一事实。

sentences.en: It just works.
sentences.zh: 它就是有效的。

sentences.en: But on social media, it just doesn’t work that way.
sentences.zh: 但在社交媒体上，情况就不是这样了。

sentences.en: If you’re on Instagram and I’m on TikTok, we can’t talk to each other.
sentences.zh: 如果你在 Instagram 而我在 TikTok，我们就无法互相交谈。

sentences.en: You have to do everything five different times and on five different apps, and it’s crazy making.

blocks.html_en: This is very nice, but it’s rare that two standards that nominally seek to achieve the same thing coexist forever. There are not two Bluetooths, there are not two Wi-Fis. There are not even two webs. People can argue with me about how many webs there are, but there are not even two webs. Do you expect ActivityPub and AT Protocol to coexist? Do you expect, I don’t know, Bluesky to be able to show content from Mastodon servers and then slowly eat ActivityPub as a protocol? That’s one very common pattern that happens in these situations. Or do you expect long-term coexistence?

blocks.html_en: I expect long-term coexistence because both of these protocols have enough users and use cases that want to continue on. Do you want that to change, and how would you change it?

blocks.html_en: Yes, we definitely want that to change. It is already changing. It certainly wasn’t designed to attract one specific group of people. It works for anyone. What we see is there is a lot of political discourse on Bluesky and any of these open networks. People are very engaged. What we’ve seen in the lead up to the election so far – we’ve hosted a lot of live election feeds, and we see a lot of really good feedback from our users, a lot of engagement, a lot of, “This is actually really interesting content about this topic.” Whereas on other platforms, I think these election topics just get completely overwhelmed by slop and spam.
